This will take you to Ellac River Cave and continue traveling north to reach the entrance to Rivermouth Cave. This is an alternate path recommended if you haven't reached Scadu Altus yet.

As you enter Rivermouth Cave, you will immediately discover the Rivermouth Cave Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map. If you go to the cavern going east, you will encounter 4 wolves in an area. In the northeast side of the room, you can pillage a body for x2 Hefty Beast Bone.

As you head deeper, the path will fork. The path on the right will have two hostile wolves along with a dead body that you can loot for x3 Sliver of Meat. This leads to a dead-end, so return to the path and follow the other path. This path will lead you to an area with an upper level and three wolves.

If you climb up the opening on the east side of the area, you will find a body containing loot. When you get closer to loot the body, the ground will collapse, making you fall. You can then loot the body to pick up a Shadow Realm Rune [1]. The path going northwest will be a dead-end, so go down the path east. As you are traversing the eastern path, you can gather x1 Sanguine Amaryllis along the way.

The path will lead you to an area full of Bloodfiends. If you want to go back up, go to the path on your right, and you will encounter a Bloodfiend. After disposing of the enemy, follow the path west going up, in which you will encounter two wolves. Keep following the path, encountering two more wolves along with a dead body that you can loot for x1 Sacred Bloody Flesh. Keep following the path, which is going north, and you will be back in the area before you fell.

If you wish to continue, you can clear the area by sneaking up on the ogres and backstabbing them. They are also easy to deal with, as you can kill them in around two hits. If you aggro them all at the same time, you can fight one of them at a time by dragging the enemies away from the area. After clearing them, you can gather a few Sanguine Amaryllis around the edges of the blood pool. On the altar, you can pick up x3 Sacred Bloody Flesh. In the northern corner of the area, near the ramp where you came from, you can pick up x6 Sanguine Amaryllis. There will be a boss fog nearby.

When you enter the boss room, you will be facing the Chief Bloodfiend. It is a more aggressive version of the Bloodfiends that you encountered earlier. It can jump towards you from afar, while also using its club more effectively than the ones you encountered earlier. For a more in-depth guide on how to defeat the Chief Bloodfiend, you can go refer to this page. Once you have defeated the Chief Bloodfiend, it will drop x1 Bloodfiend Hexer's Ashes. You can find the exit on the southeastern side of the room.

Path to Scorpion River Catacombs

The Scorpion River Catacombs is located on the far western section of Rauh Base. You can get here by traveling west past Temple Town Ruins where you will come across scarlet-inflicted pest enemies. The path here is dangerous because these enemies can stagger you while riding Torrent. From the Temple Town Ruins Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map, face the western direction and follow the river that's heading north, then to the west. You can also activate the Ravine North Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map as you are turning left. This is found on an upper section to the right side.

From the site of grace, jump down to the river below you. You will find a Horned Warrior standing in the middle of the water. You can fight it for a chance to get its armor, then, stick to the wall on your left side until you see gravestones come into view. As you reach the end here, you will see a door with 2 Ghostflame lanterns. This is your entrance to the Scorpion River Catacombs.

From the Site of Grace, head straight through the catacombs. In the first room, an Imp enemy will ambush you. Afterward, head left down a short set of stairs towards a large hallway and turn left into a small room. Inside, you'll find a corpse holding x3 Rejuvenating Boluses and two Imps guarding it. Take them out.

Exit the small room and cross the bridge in the middle of the large hallway until you find another set of stairs going down. Follow the path until you reach another large room with two Imp enemies inside. Eliminate them and head down the stairs of the large room. Just below the stairs is a corpse holding a Grave Glovewort [3]. Proceed through the tunnel entrance on the same level to find another room with an Imp guarding a plant on the left that gives you Yellow Fulgurbloom. At the other end of the room is another tunnel, but before proceeding, loot the corpse beside the tunnel to get x5 Redflesh Mushroom.

Head down the tunnel and go straight through the tight path, turning right towards another short set of stairs going down. Do not immediately exit the tunnel after turning right. There's a large spike trap that launches from above. Wait for the spike to go down, then immediately run to the right to a small space that keeps you safe from the spike trap. From here, you can either run to the right to get out of the spike area or go to the corpse on the other side that has the Ghost Glovewort [3] and then run to safety after looting it.

Once you're out of the spike trap area, turn left and drop down to another level, but be careful, as there are three Basilisks waiting to attack you. After killing the Basilisks, head through the tunnel on this level to find another corpse on the left, giving you the Shadow Realm Runes [4]. Exit the tunnel, and just to the left, you'll see another Yellow Fulgurbloom.

To the right, you'll find a ladder going up. Head up the ladder and take out an Imp enemy on the edge of the tunnel enjoying the view of the next room. Drop down into the room and loot the corpse on the right for another Ghost Glovewort [5].

Then, head to the left side of the room and up a short set of stairs. Turn left to find yourself back at the spike trap area. Cross the spike trap area again, but instead of dropping down to the Basilisk area, turn right. This leads to an open hallway with Messmer Soldiers inside. Before proceeding toward the Messmer Soldiers, run to a safe space on the right as the first half of the hallway is another spike trap. Once you cross the hallway, take out the two Messmer Soldiers and then the Black Knight with its back turned. After clearing the hallway, loot the corpse on the right near where you fought the Messmer Soldiers to get a Smithing Stone [5]. In the middle of the hallway, where the Black Knight stood, loot the altar to receive the Black Knight Captain Huw spirit.

Afterward, head back to the safe area of the second spike trap and climb the ladder going up. Once you reach the top, wait for the spike trap to go down. Before it goes back up, hop on top of it to reach a secret platform above. Loot the corpse there to get a Ghost Glovewort [6]. Hop on the spike trap again to go back to the level above the ladder.

Cross the bridge to the right, and before heading straight through the other tunnel, turn left and cross the ledge. Hop on the spike trap that goes down on the left to reach another secret platform and loot a corpse for the Imp Head (lion), paying attention to the Basilisk Eyes that active as you approach.

Return to the ledge, but before going back, turn left first to the tunnel here and enter the small room at the end. Kill two Imps guarding a corpse that gives you the Knight's Lightning Spear. Afterward, head back through the tunnel. Before exiting to the ledge area, turn left and go up the stairs to a small area with two Imps. Loot the corpse on the left to get x6 Yellow Fulgurbloom.

Once done looting, drop down near the corpse to find yourself back at the crossing point of the ledge where you crossed the bridge earlier. Go through the tunnel now and take the elevator down. Once you reach the bottom, head straight through the catacomb tunnels until you reach an intersection. Turn right and wait a few seconds for a shadow fireball trap to cross. When the shadow fireball passes and goes back, tail it down a set of stairs. There's climbable rubble up ahead, but first, check if the shadow fireball has crossed. If it has, climb up the rubble and turn right to the first path.

Follow the path until you reach a giant Imp guarding a short set of stairs. Loot the corpse to the right for a Grave Glovewort [4] before taking out the giant Imp. Head down the stairs after defeating the giant Imp and you'll find yourself in another large room. Head straight and loot the corpse and plant for a Yellow Fulgurbloom and a Ghost Glovewort [8]. Then, go down the ladder to the right of the plant and corpse. Once you reach the bottom, loot the corpse to the left for a Great Ghost Glovewort.

Head back up the ladder and turn left through another tunnel and head up the stairs. At the top, peek first because there are two Shadow Fireballs that will cross. Wait for them to pass above you and then run across the bridge. You can stop in the middle of the bridge and drop down to the left onto a small area to get a Yellow Fulgurbloom plant.

At the other end of this place, where you dropped down, is a ladder going up. Climb up to find a small room with some Imps and a chest containing the Ancient Dragon Knight's Cookbook [2]. Afterward, from the ladder, turn left through a tight tunnel that leads to the second level of a previous area. Loot the corpse on the right for x2 Rejuvenating Boluses.

Turn left towards another tunnel with a corpse containing a Broken Rune and a Yellow Fulgurbloom plant on the right. To the left of the tunnel is a drop-down path back to where the Shadow Fireball trap of the bridge you dropped down from earlier was. Cross the bridge completely and turn right at the end. There's another elevator here that goes down. At the bottom, walk straight to find a yellow mist that leads to the Death Knight boss battle. This boss drops the Death Knight's Longhaft Axe and Cerulean Amber Medallion +3.

Taylew's Ruined Forge

After clearing Scorpion River Catacombs, return to Ancient Ruins Base - Site of Grace and head north. You will come across enemies here and at the end, you will find the entrance with lit lanterns on each side. To proceed, head to the next area by heading through the nearest tunnel. You will eventually see a balcony where you can see stored lava underneath the ruins. Near your location, there's a dead body and upon looting it, receive a Shadow Realm Rune [3]. Follow the hallway and eventually, you will come across a ladder and use it to reach the lower part of the area. Follow the hallway and you will eventually come across debris and broken stone floorings that should be able to cross by jumping.

To proceed, follow the hallway and find a stone golem. Note that this enemy is resilient to physical attacks and has a lot of health. However, it is rather slow so plan your attacks and stance and break the said golem until it dies. After beating the Stone Golem, get the nearest loot which is the Smithscript Axe. Continue progressing in the dungeon by exiting back from where you came from and this time, access the lower parts by jumping into the broken part of the hallway.

Follow the hallway and you will eventually reach a long stone pillar that extends to the lava area underneath you and also extends to the upper part of the area. But first, access the adjacent area from where you are. You will come across another lava slime. Defeat and behind it, there is loot near the broken statue which contains the Smithscript Greathammer. Proceed by heading back to the stone pillar and this time head to the upper area by accessing the upper part of the stone pillar.

You will eventually notice that there are two platforms that you can jump off to. Access the one on the left and you will come to access two Stone Golems. This encounter will be challenging as both so proceed with caution. One thing to note is, that there's a red stone located at the back of these golems and these are the weak spots of these entities.

After defeating both of the golems, head to the nearest balcony where a dead body lies. Loot the body and get an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone. Head back to the area where you fought the two Stone Golem, loot another dead body, and receive x5 Smithing Stone [4].

To proceed, head back to the stone pillar and use it to get across to the adjacent platform. There are three directions that you can head from here. However, we suggest heading to the lower area by jumping from the platform you are in right now.

You are in the correct area if you landed in Lava Slimes. Follow the hallway and there's a nearby dead body that you can loot. It contains a x3 Smithing Stone [8]. Proceed by heading to the other hallway near the location where a ladder that you can access. Use the ladder to proceed.

After the ladder, you will be greeted with Lava Slimes. Take them out and notice that there's another area or platform where you can jump off too. However, a Lava Slime and another Stone Golem are waiting on the other side.

Take these enemies out and there is another dead body which you can loot. Loot it and get a x1 Somber Smithing Stone [3]. Head to the other hallway near the ladder and find yourself on another balcony. There's a nearby lever that you can interact with. Pull the lever and notice that the stone pillar will change its position so you can access the other side of the area.

To proceed, notice that there's another chained ironed platform that you can jump off to be able to return and access the pillar. But before heading to the stone pillar, notice that there's another hallway near which leads to a dead end.

There's another dead body that you can loot which contains x1 Somber Smithing Stone [3]. Head back to the previous hallway and this time, head to the other hallway which leads to a room filled with Stone Golems and Lava Slimes. You are in the right area if you notice the Elite Stone Golem that has some kind of burning ember on its head.

Deal with this enemy first and try to lure it from the pack. Be careful though as it can throw lavas at you by using the said ember. After dealing with all the enemies around this area, notice that there is debris that you can use to reach the upper area. Once you reach the upper area, notice that there's an important item to loot.

Loot the said item and receive an x1 Smithscript Shield. We are about to reach the end of this dungeon and proceed by heading back to the Stone Pillar and you will notice there's another area that you can reach on the left while climbing the stone pillar.

Reach the said area and notice that there's a ladder that you can take to proceed. Do so and you will find an altar near your location.

Interact with this Altar and you will receive the following, x1 Taylew the Golem Smith and x1 Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone. This is the end of the dungeon and access the teleporter so you can exit the dungeon. This is your last dungeon exploration in Rauh Base. If you have been following this walkthrough, you will now be heading to Shadow Keep to clear the Church District. You can teleport to the Church District Highroad - Site of Grace near the Cathedral of Manus Metyr.

IMPORTANT: This is another reminder to speak with all NPCs before you enter Shadow Keep, after you receive the loud notification that a rune has been broken, and a powerful charm too.

  • See the next tab for the Shadow Keep (Church District and Scadutree Base) Walkthrough. Click here to return to the tab selection.


Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Walkthrough - Shadow Keep (Church District and Scadutree Base)

Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Part 1 of Shadow Keep - Church District and Scadutree Base. This section covers the Church District including draining the water in the Shadow Keep and defeating the Scadutree Avatar.

  • Teleport to Church District Highroad - Site of Grace
  • Look for the Forager Brood just outside the entrance of the Church District - Shadow Keep
  • IMPORTANT: Talk to all NPCs and travel to their respective Site of Graces before you enter the Church District
  • Enter Shadow Keep through the Church District Entrance
  • Use the Prayer Room Key (from Church of the Crusade) to speak with Fire Knight Queelign: Give him Iris of Grace or Iris of Occultation.
  • Drain the water using the lever
  • Reach Sunken Chapel
  • Fight the lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit to activate the elevator and unlock the shortcut back to Church District Entrance - Site of Grace
  • Reach Tree Worship Passage - Site of Grace and then, reach Tree Worship Sanctum - Site of Grace
  • Defeat Scadutree Avatar
  • Activate Scadutree Base - Site of Grace after defeating Scadutree Avatar
  • Teleport back to Sunken Chapel Grace
  • Take the big, round elevator to Specimen Storehouse
  • Make your way to the Storehouse, Loft - Site of Grace
  • Reach Shadow Keep, Back Gate - Site of Grace (you will use this later to progress a questline and to explore Scaduview (Hinterlands).

IMPORTANT: To avoid breaking NPC questlines, make sure to follow this walkthrough and avoid entering the room of this legacy dungeon's main boss. Accidentally entering its room will lead to the cancellation of the Hornsent-Leda questline. Before entering Shadow Keep, make sure to speak with all NPCs, after you get the notification that a great rune has been broken. You will get additional dialogues from affected NPCs, and talking with them will progress their questlines.

From the Church District Highroad - Site of Grace, travel towards the entrance and look for the pest found west of the nearest Site of Grace on top of the tunnel road. Head to the cliff edge and seek the pest near the outer wall of the keep. Interact with it to receive the Forager Brood Cookbook [6]. The main entrance of the Church District of the Shadow Keep is located on the east side of the Shadow Keep. The direct path to finding it is to travel from the Church District High Road Site of Grace [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]]. You'll know you'll arrive when you enter a large doorway and pass through a long hallway. At the end of the hallway is where you'll formally arrive at the church district and discover the Church District Entrance checkpoint [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]].

The Church District is a flooded area, and the goal is to traverse the area by using high ground and finding a mechanism that drains the water. Please take note that falling into the water will result in death. Ignore the path on the left since you won't be able to use the lift until you drain the flood. Instead, jump across (using a running jump) to land on the roof of a building, then check the right side to find a small Crab and a body next to it that can be looted to acquire x2 Crab Eggs. Continue walking around the roof to find another body that's being eaten by a Crab. Loot the body to obtain x4 Thin Beast Bones. Continue south and you'll find another body being eaten by a Crab, check the body to find x2 Strip of White Flesh.

Next, jump on the floating log to reach a large broken-up circular platform. The path here is fairly straightforward, try to reach the opposite end by using the floating logs and wooden platforms, and make sure to loot the body on the circular platform to find x1 Great Grave Glovewort. Retrace your steps to the rooftop of the building where you looted bodies and killed the small Crabs, and this time, head west where you can jump across to progress (see the second image above for reference).

Once you're across, walk around the sides to reach the platform and loot the body that is guarded by Ignited Putrid Corpse enemies to obtain x1 Fireproof Pickled Liver. Jump back onto the sides of this building so you can walk to the top and proceed west where you'll have to do a running jump to safely land on top of another roof of a building. On the roof of the building, you should encounter a Fire Knight enemy walking around. Kill it and then loot the body that's near the spot where the Fire Knight enemy was walking to obtain x3 Ember of Messmer. Keep going straight until you reach a wall, then turn around to find a body sitting against one of the roof's structures. Loot it to acquire x1 Slumbering Egg [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]].

THE PRAYER ROOM: FIRE KNIGHT QUEELIGN

Next, face the east side of the compass and you should see a narrow ramp structure of one of the churches. Do a running jump to land on it safely, then walk to the top where you'll find two large openings or holes on the big roof. Slowly drop down onto the narrow structure that's on the right side, then you can walk down so you can safely run onto the other structure that is on the left so you can loot the body that holds x3 Stormhawk Feathers [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]]. Go back and then drop down onto the opening of a ceiling (see the third image above for reference).

Below, you should immediately see yet another corpse next to a small Crab. Loot the body to find x1 Lightningproof Pickled Liver. Go around, northeast, and you'll locate a locked door, this is the Prayer Room that requires the Prayer Room Key, a key that drops upon defeating the NPC Invader Fire Knight Queelign, encountered for the second time at the Church of the Crusade [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]]. If you have the key, you can unlock the door and find Fire Knight Queelign (NPC) in the flesh. Now, if you have an item called the Iris of Occultation, you can give it to the NPC, and after Queelign's dialogue, the NPC will drop a weapon you can loot. This weapon is Queelign's Greatsword. NOTE: If you give the Iris of Grace to Queelign, you'll receive the Spirit Ash "Fire Knight Queelign". The Iris of Occultation can be acquired in many ways, one way is by obtaining it as an item drop from defeating a Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit located in this area after you drain the flood.

THE FLOODED CHURCH DISTRICT: DRAINING THE FLOOD

Exit the prayer room and proceed to the northwest doorway, but before proceeding further, be sure to enter the armory room on the left to find a body sitting against the wall. Loot the body to find x1 Rune of an Unsung Hero
. Enter the hallway and kill the first Fire Knight enemy that you see, on the left side of the hallway, loot the body resting against the wall to find x2 Furlcalling Finger Remedy, and continue straight down the hallway where you'll encounter another Fire Knight. The room ahead is not accessible at the moment and the doorway to the right where you'll notice Marika's statue that has a glowing item in its hand is unreachable, so exit through the first doorway on the left side of the hallway.

NOTE: In the same hallway, there are two doorways on the left, the far most or second doorway will lead you to a lift that takes you to the Specimen Storehouse section of the Shadow Keep. You're free to roam here, but we highly recommend returning to the Specimen Storehouse after clearing the Main Plaza and Church District of the Shadow Keep. What you can do is enter the Specimen Storehouse, and activate the nearby Site of Grace (Storehouse, Back Section) so you can just fast travel here after exploring the Church District.

Cross the pathway where you'll encounter two Giant Bat enemies, then walk up to the short steps where you'll encounter another Giant Bat ahead. Jump over the gap, and kill the creature. Now before going straight, walk up a bit and you'll find a corner on the right. It's a dead end but there's a body that you can loot that's being protected by another Giant Bat hanging from the ceiling. Kill the enemy and loot the body to acquire x3 Hefty Beast Bone [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]]. Next, climb the ladder next to a doorway to find the mechanism that drains the water.

You can also return to the hallway to get the item sitting on the hand of Marika's statue. You can get the item by jumping on the hand, it may require a few tries as the platform that you need to stand on is quite narrow. Loot the item to acquire x1 Scadutree Fragment, then prepare to fight a group of Ignited Putrid Corpse as you jump down. Behind the same statue, you can find the Fire Knight's Seal weapon [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]]

EXPLORING THE SUNKEN CHAPEL

KILL THE LESSER ULCERATED TREE SPIRIT BY THE LARGE TREE

For some clarity, we recommend that you start by fast-traveling to the Church District Entrance checkpoint [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]] since you can now use the lift near the Site of Grace. From the checkpoint, go left, use the lever to call the lift, then step on the center to ride it down. You'll now be able to explore the open area of the Sunken Chapel. At the center, you will see a large tree, only approach the tree if you're prepared to fight because a Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit will emerge beneath the ground. Killing it will drop the Mantle of Thorns, and resting against the tree is a corpse holding x1 Somber Smithing Stone [5].

DEFEAT THE SECOND LESSER ULCERATED TREE SPIRIT

The second Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit is located around the east area of the sunken chapel (see the images above for reference). Defeating it will drop x1 Iris of Occultation which (if you don't have it yet) you can give to Fire Knight Queelign (see here) in the Prayer Room to obtain Queelign's Greatsword. Also in the east area, you can find open buildings. One building houses two bodies that you can loot to find x4 Smithing Stone [4] and x6 Kukri [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]].

There is also building another where you'll find a pack of Crabs and Giant Crab enemies, one roaming around, and the other next to another body that you can loot to find x1 Shadow Realm Rune [5]. [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]]. If you continue to go around this area, you'll reach the west side where you'll find the Sunken Chapel Site of Grace [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]]

FIND THE TREE-WORSHIP SITE OF GRACE

Head north towards the entrance of the main church then immediately turn left to find a corpse by a corner. Loot the body to find x3 Shadow Sunflower. Clear out the enemies then approach the small room that has Marika's statue (the same statue where you got the Scadutree Fragment and the Fire Knight's Seal weapon. Make a right and you'll enter a large room. Straight ahead, you'll see some stairs on both ends, walk up to the upper platform and investigate the railings to discover a body hanging on top of it.

Loot the body to obtain the Battlefield Priest's Cookbook [1], [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Shadow of the Erdtree Map]]]. Walk back down the stairs and check under the upper platform to find a door. Open that door and you'll find another lift that takes you underground. Ride it to find and activate the Tree-Worship Passage Site of Grace See Shadow of the Erdtree Map.

SCADUTREE AVATAR

After activating the Tree-Worship Passage Site of Grace, follow the path going down, then cross the bridge. Enter the structure through the archway, and you'll find the Iris of Grace (you can give this to Fire Knight Queelign, see here) if you still haven't obtained it. Go down the stairs on either side, and you can activate the Tree-Worship Sanctum Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map. South of the Site of Grace, you can find x1 Marika's Rune on a corpse sitting against the wall.

North of the Tree-Worship Sanctum Site of Grace, you can go through the boss fog to fight the Scadutree Avatar at the Scadutree Base. The Scadutree Avatar uses its tree trunk-like arms to attack. It has different attacks, such as uprooting thorns over an area. There is a dedicated page here containing information on how to defeat the Scadutree Avatar.

After defeating the Scadutree Avatar, you will receive the Remembrance of the Shadow Sunflower along with Miquella's Great Rune. From here, (if you followed the tip earlier by activating the Storehouse, Back Section checkpoint in the Specimen Storehouse) you can fast travel to the Storehouse, Back Section Site of Grace to start exploring the Back Section of the Specimen Storehouse.

Upon entering, look to the right immediately to see a noble corpse against the wall. Loot it to obtain x1 Somber Smithing Stone [9]. Proceed to the left side, through the doorway, where you'll find the Storehouse, Back Section checkpoint. Continue moving straight until you walk past a ladder. Do not climb the ladder first, instead, keep going straight to find some items. First, look to your left to see, another noble corpse sitting against a desk, loot it to obtain x3 Glintslab Firefly. Then at the end, you'll see a Fire Knight and three Shadow Undead standing next to another corpse, kill the enemies then loot the body to acquire x1 Carian Thrusting Shield.

Go back and climb the ladder to the top where you'll encounter another Fire Knight and two Shadow Undead reading a book. You can sneak behind the enemies to backstab them. Continue to the right side and walk carefully up the stairs to avoid aggravating the Fire Knight, roaming the floor above. At the top of the stairs, turn to the corner on the right to find a corpse to loot x3 Fire Coil. Kill the enemies on this floor, then continue moving straight. You'll discover another noble corpse sitting against a small table, loot it to obtain x4 Rada Fruit, and go straight towards the balcony to find another noble corpse that holds the Fire Serpent incantation. Go back, and look behind the bookcase to find an opening on the wall.

Through the opening, turn right and you'll find another noble corpse sitting by the edge of the narrow scaffolding. Loot the body to acquire x6 Shadow Sunflower. Continue going up, and by the ramp, you should find another noble corpse that you can loot to obtain x1 Blessed Bone Shard. Continue going up and you'll arrive at the loft section of the storehouse. Activate the Storehouse, Loft Site of Grace before you proceed to explore.

STOREHOUSE, LOFT

Once you have activated the Storehouse, Loft Site of Grace, proceed to the lift north of the Site of Grace to go up. You will end up on beams above the Specimen Storehouse. This level will be filled with Giant Bats roaming the area. The only path you can follow will be the one going west, so keep following it. There will be a lot of ways you can walk on the beams, but the only way you can progress through this area is through the ladder. Pick up x7 Thin Beast Bones from a body at the edge of a beam, then go up the ladder that you walk past through just before picking up the loot.

After climbing the ladder, you will arrive in a new level. If you go to the southeast section of the level, you can find x4 Smithing Stone [7] from a dead body. Following the path from the south side will lead you to a pillar blocking your way. If you look down, you can find a platform that you can jump off of, and it will contain the Wrath from Afar incantation. Next, jump on the beam to the north, then climb up the nearby ladder to the west of where you landed. You will end up on the beam that a pillar was blocking earlier. You can aggro the bats here, so be careful when attacking as you might fall off of the beams.

You can find a lift in the middle of the beam going west with an item above it, along with a Fire Knight on a nearby beam which will be hostile if you approach the lift.

If you use the lift to go down, you will end up in an area with a Fire Knight facing the other way around. You can easily dispose of the Fire Knight by backstabbing it and staggering it continuously. After dealing with the Fire Knight, you can pick up x1 Rune of an Unsung Hero on the southwestern corner of the area. The area will be clear, and you can head back up the beams using the lift. If you want to get the item above, you can ride the lift, then exit it before going down. A second lift will arrive just beside it, then do it again. Jump on the roof of the first lift just as it is arriving, and you will be able to reach the item, which is a Fire Knight Hilde summon.

If you walk across the beam going west, you can climb down a ladder. On your left, just around the corner, you can loot a body for x4 Rada Fruit. Directly northeast of the ladder you descended on, you will find another ladder you can use to descend. You will reach an area similar to the Site of Grace.

If you head outside the archway on the northwestern side of the area, you will find a lift directly on your right. Take the lift going down, then keep following the scaffolding until you reach an area with a door and a lift. You cannot open the door yet, so use the lift nearby to go down. The lift will then lead you to the Shadow Keep, Back Gate Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map.

This area leads you into two areas. There is a room on the east, just beside the Site of Grace. In this room, you can pick up x1 Scadutree Fragment. After that, you will see an archway heading outside on the north-northeast side of the room. This is a boss area in which you will be fighting Commander Gaius. For a more detailed guide on how to defeat Commander Gaius, you may go to this page.

Defeating Commander Gaius will give you the Remembrance of the Wild Boar Rider. It will also give access to Scaduview region. We don't recommend fighting him right away, instead, make your way to the Cerulean Coast (Southern Shore) to minimize backtracking. This covers the Church District part of your Shadow Keep exploration.

  • See the next tab for the Cerulean Coast (Southern Shore) Walkthrough. Click here to return to the tab selection.


Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Walkthrough - Cerulean Coast/Southern Shore

Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree - Southern Shore (First Entrance)

  • Travel from Ellac River Downstream - Site of Grace in Gravesite Plain and navigate the path to Cerulean Coast
  • Look for the Forager Brood to receive the Cookbook. This one is located Northeast of the Cerulean Coast - Site of Grace
  • Reach Cerulean Coast
  • Fight Ghostflame Dragon
  • Reach Southern Shore
  • Pick up Map: Southern Shore
  • Explore Stone Coffin Fissure
  • Summon Thiollier to fight the Putrescent Knight
  • Defeat Putrescent Knight
  • Reach Garden of Deep Purple
  • Progress Thiollier and St. Trina's Questline
  • Reach Southern Nameless Mausoleum and defeat Dancer of Ranah
  • Make your way to Finger Ruins of Rhia by following the path in Eastern Coast
  • Progress Count Ymir and Jolan's Questline (Please see the Finger Ruins Walkthrough Tab)

Exploring Cerulean Coast

Teleport to Castle Front - Site of Grace (this is in front of Castle Ensis). Face south, then turn left on the first dirt path. Stay on this path until a small encampment near the river comes into view. Head towards them and remain on this new dirt path. As you see the Bloodfiends and Messmer soldiers fighting, turn left again, to head towards the river. Continue down here until you get to the toxic swamp and then remain on the left side. Watch out for the Miranda Sprout of varying sizes here.

Go past the swamp and keep heading west. Keep to the left side and then jump down on the river where you see the giant Miranda Sprout. Go through the narrow entryway next to it. Once you are inside the cave, turn left, and another left until you see the site of grace. Activate the Ellac River Cave - Site of Grace before proceeding so you have a checkpoint. Next, jump down the rocks while facing south. Be careful on your way down here because you can fall off and result in an instant death. Follow the stream of the waterfall here and take your time jumping down between the stone pillars.

Once you reach the lower level, you will find gravebirds on top of pillars as you're heading south. Go through them and ride as fast as you can while sprinting with Torrent. After this area, you will jump between stone pillars again, so you need to be careful here. As you reach another lower area, you can activate another Site of Grace, the Ellac River Downstream.

Continue heading south and jump down the rocks on the right side. As you reach the lower level, you will see a giant stone pillar on your left. Cross to the other side using it as a bridge. This will take you to the ground level and you're now close to reaching Cerulean Coast. Continue riding south and go past the creatures here. As the Furnace Golem comes into view, switch to the area on the right side and remain there. It's up to you if you want this Furnace Golem, but we recommend on getting the Site of Grace first, then backtrack here to fight it later.

Continue riding south and hug this area on your right until you come across a big gap in the wall. Go through it and you will enter an area of blue flowers. You can now activate the Cerulean Coast - Site of Grace directly ahead of you. Then, you can backtrack to the area where you saw the Furnace Golem. You can also locate the Forager Brood near the forest of lightning rams here. You will receive the Forager Brood Cookbook [3] from it.

Return to the Cerulean Coast - Site of Grace. Your first stop here is obtaining the Map: Southern Shore. Head south and go past the 3 small patches of land. A Ghostflame Dragon will come swooping down here but you can just outrun it if you don't want to fight it. If you want to defeat it, you can obtain a Dragon Heart and a Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone upon killing it. Head south and go past the glowing worm creatures. You will spot the map to your right as you climb a flowery slope cut between jagged rock.

After obtaining the map, continue up the slope then make a left to travel southeast. You will reach Miquella's Cross here next to a Site of Grace. Pick up the Scadutree Fragment and interact with the Cerulean Coast - Site of Grace. This time, travel west and stick to the cliff on your left. As you're passing through the glowing worm-like creatures, and heap up the slope. Watch out for the giant that will throw boulders at you here. You can kill it for a Hefty Cracked Pot. Continue traveling south until you see a large hole in the ground. Carefully navigate to the bottom by jumping down.

You can minimize fall damage by riding Torrent as you go down and at the bottom, you will reach The Fissure - Site of Grace.

The St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook [2] can found in a cliff within the area. From Cerulean Coast Cross follow the path south until the very end to the highest cliff of the mountain. It is nearby the hole but not in the hole.

Exploring Stone Coffin Fissure

From the Site of Grace, head south and jump between the platforms until you see an enemy slime on the ground. Go past it and climb the ramp behind it and pick up x5 Congealed Putrescence at the edge.

Then, face the north direction and jump down in this thick pillar ahead of you. Make a right and pick up x10 St. Trina's Arrow from the corpse on the ground. Make a U-turn and watch out for a Bloodfiend here as you go down. It will come from the edge of the pillar. You can eliminate this enemy or just run away from it.

On the edge of this area, you will see this floor at the cliff. This is a collapsing ground and you can stand on it so you can reach the lower level. There are multiple bloodfiends here and you can eliminate them for a chance to get their items like Bloodfiend's Fork, String, or Runes. Head north towards the cliff where you see a corpse on the ground. Pick up x2 Deep-Purple Lily from this corpse. Then, face the southeast and find the way to the center of the dungeon. You will see 2 more Cursed Bloodfiends here sitting on the upper deck. Go towards them and defeat them. You can pick up the Shadow Realm Rune [3] behind them.

Fissure Cross - Site of Grace

Face the east direction where you see Miquella's Cross and a Site of Grace. Walk over it and take the Scadutree Fragment on the ground and make sure to activate the Fissure Cross - Site of Grace. From here, face northwest where you see a large chunk of collapsed stone. There is a platform that lets you jump down to the lower section.

When you reach the bottom, face east and head to the lower level. Beware of the slimes that will fall from the ceiling. To the left, you can pick up the Velvet Sword of St. Trina tucked at the end of this short cave. Go to the other path where a Gravebird is resting on the edge. Do a sneak attack and then pick up the Nectarblood Burgeon from where it was sitting. Jump down the edge and then pick up the Grave Glovewort [3] right where you will land.

Face north and go up the ramp. There's another Gravebird here with purple markings on its wings. When you reach the slanted area, you will fight another Gravebird. Going to the top, you can pick up a Grave Glovewort [2] from a corpse. Then, head down through the broken bridge here. There are caterpillar-like enemies here on your path and they can shoot out laser-like projectiles. You can try to run from them or just take them out so it's safer to navigate later on.

Once you make it to the toppled building on the other side, go to the left side by facing west where you see these stone clusters. You can trigger the explosions by getting near them and then back off as they explode. You can pick up a Grave Glovewort [8] at the end here. Then, go to the right side by facing east and go to the top of the building. Jump down on the left side to pick up Nectarblood Burgeon and x2 Smithing Stone [6] here.

To continue your progress, face northeast where you see another caterpillar-like enemy. Ideally, you want to get rid of this so it will not bother you later. Then, jump down behind the caterpillar, and jump past another stone cluster of enemies. When you see this Site of Grace come into view, go to the right side first. Pick up the Grave Glovewort [7] from this corpse on the edge. Then, activate the Fissure Waypoint Site of Grace. While facing northeast, jump to the other platform and then jump down to the lower level.

Cross the bridge and pick up the Mass of Putrescence on the other side. To continue your progress, face northeast and go up the ramp. Watch out for the fire-throwing enemies. When you get to the upper area, you can pick up Nectarblood Burgeon and Congealed Putrescence. You can just ignore these enemies after getting the item and continue going up the ramp. At the top, you will find an archway next to a Skeleton Archer.

Fight the Spirit Form of Misbegotten Crusader

Jump down the archway but watch out for the giant slime here. Take the path to your left and you will be fighting the spirit of the Misbegotten Crusader. It will drop the Multilayered Ring of Light upon defeating it. Then, jump on the platform to the southeast and cross the bridge to your left. You can pick up x3 Nectarblood Burgeon here. Then, face southeast and follow the faint glimmer of the Site of Grace. Activate it and walk up the ramp.

Go towards the horned statue and jump down. At the bottom, you will reach a boss arena. You will be fighting the Putrescent Knight here, a skeleton riding a horse. It wields a massive weapon that behaves like a boomerang and can be thrown in an arc projectile. This boss can deal a good amount of damage and you can check out our Putrescent Knight page to see more info on how to defeat this boss. This boss will drop Remembrance of Putrescence upon defeating it.

A new Site of Grace will be revealed after the fight and it will also unlock the entrance to the Garden of Deep Purple. Go inside the cave and pick up the items inside. There are Nectarblood Burgeons on the ground and a St. Trina Disciple's Cookbook [3] here. Talk to St. Trina by interacting with the bright purple flower here. This marks the beginning of Thiollier's quest which requires you to return to Pillar Path Cross - Site of Grace and speak with him there. You can also view Thiollier's page to know more about his questline. For now, you are done in this dungeon and you will return to Cerulean Coast - Site of Grace to continue exploring this region.

Southern Nameless Mausoleum

Head to the southernmost location which is towards the edge of a cliff and near a withered tree. From there, check the left to find a narrow path (below the tree) that leads to a hole that you can drop to enter a cave. The location is an arena where you can fight against a mini-boss, the Dancer of Ranah. When you reach the bottom, face the compass towards the west and go straight until you exit the cave. You can ride your mount here and avoid fighting the Giant Crab inside the cave.

As you exit, you should find yourself on the small island if you open the map. Make a right towards the shore, then up the hill on the left where you'll find a field of blue glowing flowers and the mausoleum. By the entrance, there is a Summoning Pool or effigy for players to use for co-op. There is also a Stake of Marika that you can use to respawn by the entrance of the mausoleum in case you die. As mentioned, the location is where you'll fight against a mini-boss, so make preparations before you pass through the mist. For guides and strategies on how to defeat the boss, please visit the Dancer of Ranah page or view the video guide above.

Defeating this mini-boss rewards the player with the following items:

  • Dancer's Set
  • Dancing Blade of Ranah

When you're done here, your next location is to travel to Finger Ruins of Rhia. You can go there from Cerulean Coast and you can read on the next section to find out how to get there.

  • See the next tab for the Finger Ruins of Rhia Walkthrough. Click here to return to the tab selection.


Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Walkthrough - Finger Ruins of Rhia

Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Finger Ruins of Rhia: This location is accessible from the Cerulean Coast

  • Make your way to the Finger Ruins of Rhia from Cerulean Coast
  • Travel to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr to speak with Count Ymir and Jolan
  • Progress their questline

NOTE: This section follows your encounter with Count Ymir and after exploring the Church District of Shadow Keep, traveling to Cerulean Coast, and Charo's Hidden Grave. By now, you would have acquired the O Mother (Gesture near a cliff in Bonny Village), Ruins Map, and Hole-Laden Necklace from your first meeting with Count Ymir.

IMPORTANT: This game progress spans multiple Finger Ruins: Rhia, Dheo, and Miyr. You can reach the first finger ruins from Cerulean Coast, and the second one will require you to travel to Shadow Keep, Back Gate, and the third one will be discovered as you progress Count Ymir's questline. To minimize backtracking, you need to complete Shadow Keep - Church District first. This section will only focus on the Finger Ruins of Rhia, which is a location that you can access from Cerulean Coast.

Finger Ruins of Rhia

You can reach the Finger Ruins of Rhia by traveling southeast from the Cerulean Coast - Site of Grace. Go past the toppled pillar and stick to the wall on your left side. Continue following it as you go up the ramp and past the glowing worm creatures. You will come around and find the entrance past the shoreline and behind the dragon. Go up the ramp and you will see a small-altar-like structure at the very end. You can pick up the Grave Glovewort (9) here. On the right side, you can jump down to activate the Ruins of Rhia Site of Grace.

Down here, you will be fighting Fingercreepers and the Man-Serpents. Follow the trail and make your way to the end of the path. Once you reach the bell, interact with it and you will be granted the Crimson Seed Talisman +1. Before leaving this area, explore the southwestern area of the ruins for a path with cerulean blossoms. Follow it west until you reach Finger-Weaver's Hovel, where you can obtain Finger-Weaver's Cookbook (1). This is the end of the exploration of the Finger Ruins of Rhia.

When you're done here, return to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr and speak with Count Ymir again and he will grant you the Ruins Map (2nd) and Beloved Stardust. The questlines of Count Ymir and Jolan will be put on hold while make your way to Charo's Hidden Grave. You are going there to meet the NPC named Dragon Communion Priestess, but before that, you will explore Dragon's Pit first and defeat the dungeons boss to unlock the path to Charo's Hidden Grave and the Jagged Peak.

  • See the next tab for the Charo's Hidden Grave Walkthrough. Click here to return to the tab selection.


Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Walkthrough - Dragon's Pit Path to Charo's Hidden Grave

Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree - Reaching Charo's Hidden Grave

  • Explore Dragon's Pit
  • Reach the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion
  • Reach Charo's Hidden Grave
  • Fight Death Rite Bird
  • Defeat Furnace Golem
  • Clear Lamenter's Gaol

NOTE: If you have been following this walkthrough, you would have unlocked Dragon's Pit - Site of Grace. All you need to do is teleport there and skip the bullet guide on how to reach Dragon's Pit. If you haven't unlocked Dragon's Pit, read below:

  • Teleport to Castle Front - Site of Grace
  • Head southeast and follow the dirt path
  • Go past the small army camp here
  • Stay on the dirt path (you may encounter a hostile NPC called Ancient Dragon-Man here)
  • Continue following this path and you will see Dragon's Pit Entrance on the left side

The Entrance from Dragon's Pit (The other side of Southern Shore)

Its entrance is a tight cave marked by torches outside. Once you enter the cave, you will eventually encounter the Dragon's Pit Site of Grace. Continuing through the cave, you will enter a more spacious part that resembles a ritual room. There are skeleton enemies here that you need to take out. Afterward, loot the corpse at the back of the ritual area inside a mini cave to obtain a Smithing Stone [1].

Exit the mini cave and turn left, following another tight path until you reach a cliff with a ledge path to the left. Follow the ledge and drop onto the platform below where a skeleton enemy is waiting. After defeating the enemy, go to the altar on the left and loot the corpse to find the Shadow Realm Rune [2].

Turn left from the altar and navigate another tight part of the cave until you enter a room with multiple skeleton enemies and a staircase leading up. Clear the area, then head up the staircase to find a corpse on the left holding Knot Resin. On the right, you will encounter a Lesser Magma Wyrm. After slaying the dragon, loot the corpse near a hole to obtain a Smithing Stone [5].

Return to the staircase and head downstairs until you see another tight part of the cave. After passing through, you will enter a larger section with small structures and torches. Proceed straight ahead and drop down the cliff. Though it’s a long fall, it won't kill you. Upon landing, you will immediately see a yellow mist indicating a boss ahead. Before proceeding through the mist, look back to find a corpse holding a Smithing Stone [4]. The boss in this area is the Ancient Dragon-Man. For a detailed guide on how to defeat this boss, refer to the Ancient Dragon-Man page. This boss drops the Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana.

After defeating the Ancient Dragon-Man, look to the other side where you'll find a large double door. Loot the boss and proceed through this door to reach the Dragon's Pit Terminus Site of Grace, which is also the path leading to the Jagged Peak Region where all the dragons reside. This indicates that defeating the Ancient Dragon-Man unlocks the path to the Jagged Peak Region.

Into the Dragon Area

From the Dragon's Pit Terminus - Site of Grace, head towards the east where you will encounter Jagged Peak Drake, this is a dragon resting in the middle of the open ground. It's up to you if you want to fight this dragon but you can just skip it and head west so you can avoid it. If you decide to fight it, the Jagged Peak Drake can breathe fire and stomp you with its massive legs and wings. When defeated, it drops a Dragon Heart and Dragonscale Flesh. Then, head towards the south where the path narrows. You will encounter skeletons and some fire-breathing enemies here. After a while, you will find a new location called Grant Altar of Dragon Communion.

Speak to the NPC named Dragon Communion Priestess to receive Ancient Dragon's Blessing. There's also a nearby Site of Grace that you can activate here. This is your last stop before heading to Charo's Hidden Grave.

Charo's Hidden Grave

Head up the dragon's body by facing southwest. Climb it to the top then face south until the red flowers come into view. Then,turn right to formally enter Charo's Hidden Grave. Head southwest until you make it to Charo's Hidden Grave. This area is filled with various gravesite locations and are guarded by mostly skeleton enemies. This is a location filled with red flowers on the ground and is the area above Cerulean Coast.

Jump down into the water and then pick up the Grave Keeper's Cookbook [2] Continue riding northwest and you will see a Tibia Mariner here on the water. Defeat this enemy to obtain Tibia's Cookbook. After defeating the Tibia Mariner, you can head east to find a Grave Keeper's Brainpan which is surrounded by trees and rocks on a drop. Then, continue riding northwest to activate the Charo's Hidden Grave Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map before a small archway and near the cliff edge. From here, you can even see the Cerulean Coast at the lower area. Northeast of the Site of Grace, you can find a Deathbird statue surrounded by Gravebirds, in which you'll find the Rings of Spectral Light sorcery at the base of the statue.

Beyond this area, you will fight a Death Rite Bird. This is an optional boss found in the middle of the body of the lake here. If you defeat the Death Rite Bird in this place, you will obtain the Ash of War: Ghostflame Call. Now, return to the Site of Grace, then head north to obtain the Spirit Glaive halberd. Afterwards, you can head southwest until you encounter a Hippopotamus. Defeat it, and you will obtain a Scadutree Fragment from it as a drop.

Head west and go past the Blue Worms. You will start to see metal barricades and broken prison cages. Stick to the wall on your right and you will find the entrance to Lamenter's Gaol with red flowers leading to it. Head inside until you find the Lamenter's Gaol Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map

Lamenter's Gaol

At the Lamenter's Gaol Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map, keep following the path going southeast until you arrive near a locked gate. Before the locked gate, there will be an opening on the left side of the wall. Go through the path on your left, then keep following the path.

You'll find two rooms with an open gate on the right side as you are traversing the path. The first room will only contain a Putrid Corpse. In the second room, you will encounter two Putrid Corpses. After dealing with the enemies in this room, open the chest to receive x1 Gaol Upper Level Key, which will be used to open the locked gate that you encountered earlier. Return to the path then keep following it until you cross a bridge. Enter the room across the bridge, in which you will encounter a Living Jar along with a Putrid Corpse. The room will be filled with numerous cages. On the northern side of the room, you'll find another room with three cages. On a dead body by the middle cage, you can pick up x1 Prattling Pate Lamentation.

Gaol Upper Level

Open the locked gate to get inside a room with a ladder and x1 Frozen Maggot that you can pick up. Climb down the ladder, and you will arrive in an area covered in ice. Living Jars will be running around the place, which you can easily deal with as they die in a few hits. You can also pick up numerous Frozen Maggots in the area, as they are scattered all around the area.

There are four rooms in the area that you can enter. In the room closest to the entrance, on the eastern side, you can pick up x1 Chilling Perfume Bottle. The second room will be the initially closed, but you can open the gate without any key. The room will contain a ladder going down, which will be useful later on. The third room will be the only room that is located a bit higher than the other rooms, requiring you to make a few small jumps. Lastly, in the northernmost room, you will find Living Jars around the room along with a locked gate on the northwestern corner of the room. There will also be a hole near the entrance that leads to loot.

Loot Detour and Navigating the Place

Near the entrance of the third room, you will encounter a Living Jar along with a Putrid Corpse patrolling the nearby room. Head inside the area that seems to be a jail area, onto another room on the eastern side. The cells couldn't be opened, so keep heading east. In the second room, the floor will collapse, making you fall into an area in which you will be surrounded by Putrid Corpses.

Go through the doorway, then keep following the path. You'll see a Putrid Corpse sitting on a cliff along the way. Head up the stairs to proceed further into Lamenter's Gaol. In the middle of the stairs, there will be a room on its landing. Enter the room then keep following its path, leading you to a room containing two Putrid Corpses and a dead body that you can loot for x1 Call of Tibia. Head back out the room, then continue walking up the stairs. There will be another landing with a Putrid Corpse hiding behind the corner. A room will be on the northern side of the landing. The room leads to an area overlooking the room filled with Living Jars.

Retrieving the Gaol Lower Level Key

Go down the slope, then defeat all the Living Jars in the area to freely explore it. On a structure made out of piled-up remains, you can pick up a Hefty Cracked Pot on top of it in the middle of small Living Jars holding hands. You can follow a path going southwest of the room, revealing just how big the whole area is. You can pick up x6 Living Jar Shard from a body on the southwestern corner of the area. A chest will be in the middle of the southwestern section part of the room, which you can acquire the Gaol Lower Level Key from when opening it. After acquiring the key, return to the stairs, then keep going up.

After obtaining the Gaol Lower Level Key, return to the room where you got the Call of Tibia from, but do not enter it. On the southern wall near the doorway to the room is an illusory wall that leads to a locked gate. Use the Gaol Lower Level Key on the locked gate, then enter the room. In this room, you can find a Shadow Realm Rune [4] and the Lamenting Visage torch. Head out the room by following the path going north.

When you get to the top of the stairs, enter the room. A Living Jar is hiding on the left side which can attack you by surprise if you aren't aware of it. Keep following the path, going through the doorway on the west side. If you jump down to the room, it will lead you back to the northernmost room. Head out of the room, then keep exploring the area containing many rooms if you haven't done that.

More Loot Detour

If you want to clear the area, jump down the hole near the entrance of the frozen room. After jumping, you'll find x2 Innard Meat from a dead body nearby. Follow the path going west. You will arrive in a dark area containing two Giant Rats. It's a dark area, so it is advisable to use a torch for this part. After dealing with the rats, follow the path going west, heading deeper into Lamenter's Gaol. You will encounter more Giant Rats in this area, which you deal with easily. In this room, there will be two paths that you can take. The path on the right will have a ladder going up, but two giant rats will be in the area. The ladder going up will lead you back to the frozen area with many rooms. The left path heads deeper into Lamenter's Gaol, leading you into a room with Giant Rats. You can also pick up the Clarifying Horn Charm +2 from a body near the blocked off path. The area being blocked is the one where you retrieved the Gaol Lower Level Key earlier.

To make your way back, go back to the tunnel where you came from. The path will then fork, a left and a right path. The right path leads to where you came from. The left path will be the one that leads back to the frozen room, as it leads you back to the ladder room you found earlier.

Facing The Lamenter

Make your way back to the frozen room by following the path, then head to the northernmost room filled with jars. You can use the Gaol Lower Level Key to open the locked door. Once you have unlocked the door, go down the ladder. You will see a boss fog directly in front of you. Prepare yourself for combat, as you will be facing the boss of this area, the Lamenter.

The Lamenter is a boss that is smaller than the usual bosses you encounter in this game. The Lamenter is an agile boss that relies on the use of its clones to deceive and confuse the player. Its clones will die in one hit, but hitting the clones will not damage the real Lamenter. Here is an in-depth guide for defeating the Lamenter.

After defeating the Lamenter, you will receive the Lamenter's Mask helm. The exit will be located on the southeastern side of the room.

  • See the next tab for the Scaduview Walkthrough. Click here to return to the tab selection.


Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Walkthrough - Scaduview

DESCRIPTION HERE

  • Teleport to Shadow Keep, Back Gate - Site of Grace
  • Defeat Commander Gaius to access Scaduview
  • Use the Scaduview - Site of Grace after defeating the boss
  • Go to Albinauric's Shack
  • Head north to Scadutree Chalice and get the x5 Scadutree Fragment

NOTE: This area is only accessible after you have completed the Shadow Keep - Church District exploration. Make sure to read the full Shadow Keep (Part 1) to know how to reach this location.

After exploring Charo's Hidden Grave and clearing Lamenter's Gaol, you will now teleport to Shadow Keep, Back Gate - Site of Grace to advance your game. Face north and go through the archway to fight Commander Gaius. You can view this page to read a comprehensive guide on how to defeat the boss. Use the newly-spawned Scaduview - Site of Grace and from here, head through the archway on the north. Keep following the path north until you see a broken-down house on the west of the path. Approach it, and you will be at the Albinauric's Shack.

Albinauric's Shack

From the Scaduview Site of Grace, head through the archway on the north. Keep following the path north until you see a broken-down house on the west of the path. Approach it, and you will be at the Albinauric's Shack.

An Albinauric Wolfback Archer will be stationed in the Albinauric Shack. Once you have defeated the Albinauric Wolfback Archer, you can loot it to receive Gaius's Greaves.

Head inside the shack to obtain the only item there, a Sharpshot Talisman.

Return to the path going north, and you will see a big wall structure with an archway in the middle. Go through the archway in the middle, and you will be in Scadutree Chalice.

In Scadutree Chalice, there will be 6 items on the ground that you can pick up. There are x5 Scadutree Fragments and a Blessed Bone Shard by the giant chalice.

That's all there is in Scaduview for this tab. Continue reading the next one to enter Hinterlands in Scaduview (located east of where you fought Commander Gaius.

  • See the next tab for the Hinterlands (Scaduview) Walkthrough. Click here to return to the tab selection.


Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Walkthrough - Hinterlands

Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree - Hinterlands (continuing the quest of Count Ymir and Jolan)

  • Reveal the entrance to Hinterlands through the Statue of Marika in Shadow Keep, Back Gate (This is part of the Finger Ruins Questline that includes Count Ymir and Jolan)
  • Defeat Tree Sentinel
  • Explore Shaman Village
  • Cross the bridge and use Hinterland Bridge - Site of Grace

NOTE: You can only enter this area after you have obtained the O Mother (Gesture) near Bonny Village in Scadu Altus. This exploration picks up from the Shadow Keep (Church District exploration) and will continue from the Shadow Keep, Back Gate - Site of Grace. Teleport there and follow this guide to help you explore Scaduview and reach the Hinterlands while progressing the quests related to Finger Ruins, Count Ymir, and Jolan.

How to Access Hinterlands

Fast travel to the Shadow Keep, Back Gate Site of Grace, facing the entrance of the structure, go left and you will find a Summoning Pool that you can activate and a room you can go into. Head into the room, on the left is a message that reads "Have mercy, For the spirited-away shamans." and straight ahead you can pick up the Scadutree Fragment at the altar. At the altar, you will need to perform the O Mother Gesture in front of the altar to trigger it to move.

Go through the hidden tunnel and you will find yourself at the Hinterlands. You can activate the Site of Grace as soon as you exit the tunnel and go down the steps. To begin exploring, you will head to Shaman Village. From the Site of Grace, follow the main path on your right and as you turn here, near the ramp, you will encounter a Tree Sentinel. This is a field boss that you can run away from if you can get far enough. You can ride Torrent inside this location so take advantage of that if you don't want to defeat this boss. Head up the ramp to the east and keep going until the Shaman Village flashes on your screen.

Once you cross the bridge entering the village, head straight through the garden of flowers, and you'll find a Minor Erdtree plant in the middle of the garden, specifically illuminated by sunlight.

After looting the Minor Erdtree, head up the hill to the left where there are abandoned structures, and turn right towards the cliff overlooking an abandoned house below. By the edge of the cliff, you'll find Marika's Rune.

Afterward, continue up the hill to see more abandoned structures. On the right side of the area, you'll find a large tree with an open trunk. Inside this tree trunk, you can loot a corpse to obtain the Golden Braid.

When you're done here, head back down the ramp where you encountered the Tree Sentinel. This time, head northeast and turn right as you go down the ramp. There's another Tree Sentinel here that you can choose to fight or run away from. Continue ahead and go past the bridge. Use the Hinterlands Bridge - Site of Grace before proceeding.

Finger Ruins of Dheo

Head east and continue the path facing the withered tree. After a short while of riding, you can see the Fingestone Hill - Site of Grace. Activate it, then continue traveling in the eastern direction and the Finger Ruins of Dheo will come into view. This area is covered with thick fog and can become difficult to navigate at night. You can pass the time to make navigating easier.

Head south until you reach the end. You can interact with the bell and you will be granted the Cerulean Seed Talisman +1. When you're done here, you will return to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr and speak to Count Ymir and he will give you the Ruins Map (3rd).

IMPORTANT: The remaining section of this guide will tell you how to complete the questline of Count Ymir and Jolan, which takes place in the Finger Ruins of Miyr. Read below to find out more so you can get the best results of their quests.

Return to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr

With the third map, make sure to rest at a grace somewhere else and then fast-travel to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr so Count Ymir will not be there. Make your way over to the throne you once met Count Ymir on. This time, you can examine the throne. Interact with it to see it slide back and reveal a rope ladder, take the ladder down to reach the Finger Ruins of Miyr.

Finger Ruins of Miyr under the Cathedral

Once you head down, an NPC invader Swordhand of Night Anna will appear. Defeat her and you will be granted the Claws of Night. You will be able to find a few Finger Mimics scattered around the area, other than that, you can find the Finger-Weaver's Cookbook (2) on a body on the lower left walkway of the path. Nearing the bell, you can interact with the Summoning Pool to activate it and then interact with the hanging bell to teleport you to the Metyr, Mother of Fingers arena.

Once you Defeat Metyr, Mother of Fingers you will be granted 420,000 Runes, and the Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers. You can then fast-travel back to the Cathedral of Manus Metyr and head back to the throne and interact with it once more to encounter another NPC invader named Swordhand of Night Jolan. Defeat her and you will have to face Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers. This is when Count Ymir borrows the powers of Metyr to fight you. Defeat her and you will be granted the High Priest Set that comes with the High Priest Hat, High Priest Robe, High Priest Gloves, and High Priest Undergarments, as well as Ymir's Bell Bearing and the Maternal Staff.

Once you've successfully defeated both, rest at the Site of Grace and return to Jolan's initial spot to find her sitting on the ground against the pillar. As you approach Jolan, she will tell you she's losing her vision, and can't see the sky or the stars. You have 2 options for what item you want to give:

  • Iris of Grace: Giving this item will turn Jolan into Swordhand of Night Jolan.
  • Iris of Occultation: Giving this item will make Jolan pass quietly and they will drop the Sword of Night, thus ending her questline.

IMPORTANT: Giving her the Iris of Grace will continue her questline where you can combine the ash with another to make it more powerful. You may only give her either the Iris of Occultation or the Iris of Grace to obtain only one reward per playthrough.

To continue Jolan's questline, you need to return to Hinterlands, go to Shaman Village, and go to the very top of Rabbath's Rise. Look for a pathway at the back of the village, and travel down the cliffside, leading to a secret top part of Rabbath's Rise. Here you will find her puppet body, where you will be asked to combine the spirits together, claiming the Jolan and Anna Spirit Summon.

NOTE: If you don't have these required items yet, read below if you want to find out where you can get Iris of Occultation and Iris of Grace.

Iris of Occultation locations:

  • Acquired as an item drop from defeating a Lesser Ulcerated Tree Spirit located in this area after you drain the flood in the Church District. See Shadow of the Erdtree Map
  • Acquired as an item drop from a Lesser Omenkiller. Drop down the well in the main arena of Fort of Reprimand. The enemy will ambush you there among some items. See Shadow of the Erdtree Map

Iris of Grace locations:

  • Can be looted at the Specimen Storehouse of the Shadow Keep. See Shadow of the Erdtree Map
  • Can be found at the base of the headless statue of Marika in the building west of the Sunken Chapel. Drain the water in the church district, and follow the path of the Tree-Worship Passage to find the statue there. See Shadow of the Erdtree Map
  • See the next tab for the Jagged Peak Walkthrough. Click here to return to the tab selection.


Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Walkthrough - Jagged Peak

Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree - Navigating Jagged Peak

  • From the Dragon's Pit Terminus - Site of Grace, travel to Foot of Jagged Peak - Site of Grace and defeat the 2 Jagged Peak Drake
  • Talk to Igon and receive Igon's Furled Finger
  • Fight Ancient Dragon's Senessax
  • Summon Igon to defeat Bayle The Dread
  • Return to Igon's location near Foot of the Jagged Peak where you fought the 2 Dragons
  • Return to Dragon Communion Priestess

Head out to the Foot of the Jagged Peak by returning to where you fought the first dragon, but this time, you will head north and pass through the pillars. This will take you to the cliff of the mountain.

Use the Spiritspring at the end of this path, then veer right and cross the bridge. Activate the Foot of the Jagged Peak site of grace here before proceeding. This is very important because you will be fighting a boss in the next area. This is where you will respawn if you die during the fight.

Next, continue up ahead until you reach the boss arena. You will be fighting another Jagged Peak Drake, but this time, there will be two of them. After this fight, you will hear the voice of Igon nearby. Locate him towards the east and head towards the area where the red smoke is thick. Talk to him there and exhaust his dialogues. He will ask you to summon him and let him join you in the fight against Bayle The Dread. You will receive Igon's Furled Finger.

From here, take the Spiritspring behind him, and another one at the next level. On the third level, you will see the entrance to the cave of the next dragon. Go inside the cave and watch out for the rolling boulders here. You can avoid it by going to the right area of the cave, and then crossing to the left as soon as the boulder rolls down. Before crossing, you also need to pay attention to an item on your right at the end and pick up the Scadutree Fragment here. Once you make it to the left side of the room, you will reach the arena of another boss.

You will be fighting Ancient Dragon Senessax. After defeating this boss, go up the north exit where you will see the remains of other dragons on the ground. This serves as your guide that you are headed to the right place.

Outside this area, activate the Jagged Peak Mountainside - Site of Grace. Then, head to the top of the mountain by heading southwest. You will see the dragon remains here and keep following it. There are also lightning effects that will occasionally strike. Then, use the Spiritspring and continue going to the south.

Stick to the wall here to your left and use another Spiritspring. You will find yourself at a level with multiple dragon remains and a small cave entrance in front of you. Go inside and pick up the Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone on the right side, then walk over to your left and use another Spiritspring at the end.

Use the Site of Grace at the top and this is the one that you will be using in case you die during the boss fight. (Beware: You probably will). Go towards the small opening here and once you enter the arena, Bayle The Dread will land once you are inside. Now, the key to completing Igon is to summon him here. He can't be summoned from the outside but you need to locate his summon sign inside the arena after this boss fight is triggered.

After defeating this boss, return to Igon's last location where you fought the two Jagged Peak Drake. See the SOTE Elden Ring DLC Map He will drop his items that you can loot:

  • Igon's Greatbow
  • Igon's Helm
  • Igon's Armor
  • Igon's Gauntlets
  • Igon's Loincloth
  • Igon's Bell Bearing

Once you have collected these items, go to the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion. Teleport to the site of grace that you previously used. The Dragon Communion Priestess has vanished and will leave the following items behind:

  • Priestess Heart
  • Flowerstone Gavel

NOTE: There is an alternate ending for this NPC quest, but there are some requirements to meet before your fight with Bayle. The following requirements are:

  • Meet Thiollier before Moore leaves the Main Gate Cross Site of Grace
  • Speak to Moore and receive the Black Syrup from Thiollier
  • Give Thiollier the Black Syrup in exchange for Thiollier's Concoction

After you have met all these requirements, you will need to see the Dragon Communion Priestess at night. She will be seen speaking with Lord Placidusax. You can speak to her and give her Thiollier's Concoction.

(IF GIVEN THE CONCOCTION SHE WILL NOT DROP THE PRIESTESS HEART OR THE GAVEL)
If you give her Thiollier's Concoction she will fall asleep, wait 1 full day and she will wake up and express disappointment that she had succumbed to slumber.

After defeating Bayle, return to her and she will give you the Dragonbolt of Florissax Incantation. Then if you confess that it was you that put her to sleep she will pledge to follow you and you will be given the Ancient Dragon Florissax Spirit Ashes.

  • See the next tab for the Shadow Keep Depths (Recluse River) Walkthrough. Click here to return to the tab selection.


Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Walkthrough - Shadow Keep Depths (Main Gate to Recluse River)

Entering Shadow Keep to Main Gate to gain access to Recluse River and Eastern Scadu Altus

  • Teleport to Highroad Cross - Site of Grace
  • Head north and enter Shadow Keep through the Main Gate (defeat the Furnace Golem if you haven't)
  • Fight Golden Hippopotamus
  • Exit through the northeast and make your way around this section to unlock the shortcut back to the Main Gate Plaza - Site of Grace (NOTE: It is recommended to help Hornsent in this fight and use the gold summon sign since you can encounter Hornsent later on to get his items. You can earn additional rewards if you assist Hornsent to defeat Leda: Ash of War: Swift Slash and Leda's Rune.)
  • Head back out through the southeast and do the Hornsent vs Leda fight
  • Get Domain of Dragons Painting
  • Reveal the Illusory Wall and ride the coffin
  • Use the Castle Watering Hole - Site of Grace (explore here later)
  • Eliminate the Furnace Golem
  • Explore the Ruins of Unte
  • Reach Village of Flies
  • Make your way to Eastern Nameless Mausoleum and defeat Rakshasa
  • Complete Darklight Catacombs
  • Defeat Jori, Elder Inquisitor, and go through the new area

NOTE: This portion of the Game Progress Route will guide you on how to reach the area under Shadow Keep and explore the path to Recluses' River that will let you access the following locations: Ruins of Unte, Eastern Nameless Mausoleum and Darklight Catacombs in the Eastern Scadu Altus.

IMPORTANT: Needle Knight Leda and Hornest questline may get bricked if you accidentally enter the main boss in Shadow Keep. Make sure to read this guide to avoid canceling quests unintentionally.

Shadow Keep (Entering through the Main Gate)

The main entrance of the Shadow Keep is pretty linear, as you can follow the path directly from Castle Ensis leading to the main entrance of the Shadow Keep. Along the path, you will encounter Messmer Soldiers in encampments, so tread carefully. By the eastern section of the keep's outer walls, you can loot a fallen Furnace Golem for x1 Furnace Visage. Nearby, you can find a tent containing a corpse with x1 Furnace Keeper's Note. Return to the path, and you will find a big archway to a room containing a lift. This will take you to the Shadow Keep Main Gate Site of Grace [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Elden Ring Map]]].

When you arrive at the top of the lift, activate the Site of Grace. The area ahead of it is a boss room. Once you are ready to fight it, enter the room and you will encounter the Golden Hippopotamus. Its attacks have a deceptively big hit box, using mostly its head to attack. For more guides and strategies on how to defeat the boss, you can visit this page. After defeating the Golden Hippopotamus, it will drop x2 Scadutree Fragment and the Aspects of the Crucible: Thorns incantation. Defeating the Golden Hippopotamus will give you access to the Main Plaza of the Shadow Keep, allowing you to explore the whole area. The Main Gate Plaza Site of Grace [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Elden Ring Map]]] will be unlocked after the boss fight, so you can activate it now.

The Main Plaza and Boss Fight

After defeating the Golden Hippopotamus, you can head to the western archway to continue heading deeper into the Shadow Keep. Follow the path, and you will encounter two Messmer Soldiers overlooking the ledge on your left. After defeating them, pick up the Festive Grease from a corpse, and you'll encounter another Messmer Soldier going down the stairs.
