In the middle of the stairs, you can find a room with two more Messmer Soldiers along with a corpse that you can loot for x6 Smithing Stone [1]. You can find another room connected to this room on the right side, which contains two more Messmer Soldiers along with a Black Knight. On the dead body by the south side of the room, you can pick up the dagger Main-gauche. Afterwards, head back out the stairs on the west, then keep going up.

You will encounter two Messmer Soldiers looking over the ledge on the left with a corpse that you can loot for x7 Redflesh Mushroom, and two more Messmer Soldiers on the right. After defeating the Messmer Soldiers, head up the stairs again to find another room. There will be three Black Knights inside the room; one wielding a hammer and greatshield, the second one using a greatbow, and the third one wielding a twinblade. You can deal with the first Black Knight by dragging him outside of the room to where you came from, then you can deal with the other two easily inside the room. On the opening on the south wall of the room, you can pick up x1 Golden Vow from corpse hanging by the ledge and x1 Shadow Realm Rune [6] from a body near the archway on the east.

Exploring the Plaza

As you head out of the room, you can drop down from the bridge on the left side, and you'll find x5 Smithing Stone [5] from a dead body. Continue heading south, and you will see a golden tree. Directly beside it, you can pick up the Talisman of Lord's Bestowal. On the room south of the tree, you can pick up x2 Smithing Stone [8] from a dead body on the ledge northwest of the room. Northwest of the plaza, you can find a Black Knight facing a dead body with an item. Defeat the Black Knight, then pick up the x3 Golden Vow on the dead body. You can get back up by entering the room east of the corpse, which will contain a Messmer Soldier and a Black Knight. A ladder room will be on the eastern side, which leads you back to the room with the three Black Knights that you just fought.

Shortcut access back to Main Plaza Grace

After opening the door back to the room, head east again through the archway to continue progressing through the Shadow Keep. On the northeastern side, which is a dead-end, you can loot a body for x1 Holyproof Pickled Liver. Keep following the path going to the southeast, and you'll encounter Shadow Militiamen by the boats. By the stairs heading up, you can pick up x1 Messmerfire Grease from the dead body lying on the stairs. South of it, you can find a ramp going down, in which you will encounter more Shadow Militiamen. Open the double door, which leads you back to the Main Gate Plaza Site of Grace.

Obtain Domain of Dragons Painting

From the Main Gate Plaza - Site of Grace, exit through the door while facing Southeast. This will take you to an area with Satyr enemies. Outside, go up the ramp and make a right to the burning boats. Then, use the ladder on the left side to go down near a waterfall to the left.

Walk towards the waterfall to reveal a room here. Take the ladder going down and go through the door to your left. You will see the Domain of Dragons Painting here. Interact with it, then pay attention to the wall behind you.

Path to Ruins of Unte and Eastern Scadu Altus Dungeons

This blank wall is a secret passage and you can attack it to reveal a new area. This will lead you to an area beneath Eastern Scadu Altus region and allows you to reach Eastern Nameless Mausoleum and Darklight Catacombs. To continue, go through the secret room and follow the stream of water.

Go down the steps and turn left. You will see a coffin at the edge here. Rest in the coffin to travel to a new location.

After the short cutscene plays you will arrive at a new location. Go through the door then activate the Castle Watering Hole - Site of Grace left of the doorway. Then, summon Torrent and ride southeast here. You will come across a Furnace Golem here and it's up to you if you want to defeat it. You will arrive at Ruins of Unte, a new area that you can explore.

When you first arrive at the Ruins of Unte, you'll encounter one Furnace Golem that rises when you approach it See Shadow of the Erdtree Map. Defeating this Furnace Golem drops the Oil-Soaked Tear crystal tear and a Furnace Visage. Defeat it and head toward the ruins and you'll notice one "dead" or "unlit" Furnace Golem blocking the ruins' entrance. Head to the east side and use your mount to jump over the rubble and remains of the buildings until you reach the balcony overlooking the "dead" Furnace Golem. To wake up the Golem, you need to have a Hefty Furnace Pot in your inventory, equip it, and throw it on its head.

A Hefty Furnace Pot can be crafted with the following materials: x1 Redflesh Mushroom, x1 Ember of Messmer, and x1 Furnace Visage. The recipe to learn how to craft this item requires the player to acquire the Greater Potentate's Cookbook (2) item which can be looted from a dead body at the Run-Down Traveler's Rest in Gravesite Plain See Shadow of the Erdtree Map. Defeating this awakened Furnace Golem drops the x1 Bloodsucking Cracked Tear and x1 Furnace Visage.

From the Castle Watering Hole - Site of Grace, travel south and you will stick to the mountain side on your left. Make sure to pay attention to the gaps on the platform here. Once the path to the left side ends, jump over to the other side. This time, you will stick to the mountainside to the right.

From here, you can activate the Recluses' River Downstream - Site of Grace. This is important because you will be returning to this location to reach the Southern Shore. Next, you will go down some platforms near this Site of Grace. When you reach the river level, head north and turn right until you reach the end where you'll find the Eastern Nameless Mausoleum and the Darklight Catacombs.

By the entrance, there is a Summoning Pool or effigy for players to use for co-op. There is also a Stake of Marika that you can use to respawn by the entrance of the mausoleum in case you die. As mentioned, the location is where you'll fight against a mini-boss, so make preparations before you pass through the mist. For guides and strategies on how to defeat the boss, please visit the Rakshasa boss page. Defeating this mini-boss rewards the player with the following items:

  • Rakshasa Set
  • Rakshasa's Great Katana

Village of Flies

NOTE: You can reach this area by traveling from the Castle Watering Hole - Site of Grace, or if you have activated the Recluses' River Downstream - Site of Grace, you can teleport there and start your path from the next paragraph. From the Castle Watering Hole - Site of Grace, you will come across a Furnace Golem next to the the ruins and you can ignore it and follow the stream. Head southwest and scale the wall on your left side. You will be able to activate the Recluses' River Upstream Site of Grace here. Continue scaling the wall and occasionally jumping between platforms. Pay attention to the flooring here as a gap separates some. When you reach the end, cross to the right side and still, continue heading towards the southern direction. From here, flies will now start attacking you. This is when a small village will come into view on the eastern side. To get there, you first need to get past it, come around, and drop to the platform ahead of you.

You will be able to activate and rest at the Recluses' River Downstream - Site of Grace here. After activating this site, you will jump down and continue navigating ahead. You will know that you are in the right area if there are Giant Flies on your path. As you reach the ground level, a Curseblade will attack you. Watch out because this fight can be difficult because the other Giant Flies will also attack you here.

After the fight, explore the western direction and you will find a Revered Spirit Ash on the small altar. Then, go around it and jump up the stones to reach the small, elevated area. You can pick up a Silver Horn Tender here found next to destroyed pots and corpses. Then, go to the top part of the village, and loot the Man-Fly Ashes guarded by two Shadow Undead and several Man-Fly enemies. That wraps up the quick exploration of Village of Flies and you will now head to Darklight Catacombs where your goal is to defeat Jori, Elder Inquisitor and activate the site of grace that spawns after the fight. This allows you to teleport here later when you are ready to explore Abyssal Woods (which is recommended after clearing Jagged Peak).

Darklight Catacombs

The Darklight Catacombs is located south of the Scadu Altus region, directly south of the Eastern Nameless Mausoleum. To get there, go to the Recluses' River Downstream Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map, then go traverse the cliffs going south. As you get to the bottom, keep going south. By going in this direction, you will stumble upon the door leading to the Darklight Catacombs. Open the door to gain access inside the catacombs.

Once you are inside the Darklight Catacombs, follow the path leading to a lift. After arriving at the bottom, you can activate the Darklight Catacombs Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map. After activating the Site of Grace, head north to pick up x1 Grave Glovewort [5]. A lionhead Imp will jump on you as you approach the item, so take caution. Once you have picked up the Grave Glovewort, go to the eastern hall right before picking up the loot. Grab x1 Yellow Fulgurbloom right as you head down the path. Turn left, and you'll find another path going down, with x1 Yellow Fulgurbloom in the middle of the stairs.

You will arrive on a ledge area with two Fanged Imps. Defeat the enemies, then drop down the ledge or walk down the ramp. Immediately on the west of where you dropped is a passageway leading to a lever that will turn on the lights when pulled. Go back to where you dropped, then head southeast, passing through the archway. As you turn the corner to the archway, a Bigmouth Imp will attack you.

In the room overlooking the lit area, you can drop from the railings onto a ledge, then drop from the broken section of the ledge to a room with a chest containing the Viridian Amber Medallion +3. Afterwards, drop down to a bridge. The room on the south connecting to the bridge contains x1 Grave Glovewort [1] on the east side, and x2 Yellow Fulgurbloom right by the western wall. After clearing the area, follow the path going north leading to another lift. Use the lift to go down.

Follow the path north, going through the ramp on the right side to progress. A Fanged Imp will be waiting for you at the bottom of the ramp. Keep heading north, and you'll find x1 Yellow Fulgurbloom along with a bigmouth Imp opposite of it. After dealing with the imp, go back a few steps and you'll see a ladder going up. Climb the ladder, then turn right through the tight passageway, dropping to a room with a lever. Pull the lever, and you will activate the lights in another area. By the lever, you can drop down safely into a staircase below containing x4 Thin Beast Bones. Follow the path going up the stairs.

Once you have arrived at the top of the second set of stairs, look down by the opening, then drop down to the ledge. Follow the ledge going west, then climb up the ladder in the corner. In front of you, you can pick up x1 Shadow Realm Rune [5] from a corpse, and you will encounter an Inquisitor. You can safely drop to the room below with a body that has x1 Ghost Glovewort [2]. A Fanged Imp will attack you from behind after dropping. You can exit through the archway to the east. You'll be back in the area where you climbed up a ladder to the lever room.

You'll find a broken section of the railings. Drop down to the ledge bellow it, and you'll find a hallway with an Inquisitor on the southeastern corner. In this hallway, you can obtain the Death Knight Set from a dead body by the ledge on the north. South of the hallway, you can find an opening with a ladder going down. Climb down the ladder then head east through the archway. On your left, you'll find x1 Ghost Glovewort [9]. On your right, a Inquisitor will be attacking you. Defeat the Inquisitor, then drop down the ledge.

After dropping down, you can pick up x1 Yellow Fulgurbloom just where you dropped. Go east, then go through the archway going down, leading you to another lift. After arriving at the bottom of the lift, keep heading east. You will encounter a giant Bigmouth Imp which shoots fireballs towards you. Run through it, then turn left to head north. There will be a section here that has a pillar that can serve as a safe spot for you. As you are in the safe spot, a Fanged Imp will approach you. After dealing with the Fanged Imp, sprint to the area where it came from, then pull the lever in the room. Afterwards, kill the giant Bigmouth Imp, then defeat the Fanged Imp that spawns after it.

NOTE: Do not kill the Giant Bigmouth Imp before pulling the lever, or else the Great Ghost Glovewort that it drops will be stuck on the platform.

Go back to where you dropped, and you can pick up x2 Yellow Fulgurbloom and x1 Ghost Glovewort [8]. Afterwards, head to the pathway that the giant Bigmouth imp was blocking, then enter the room to loot a chest containing x1 Bigmouth Imp Ashes. Head up the stairs on the eastern wall, then keep heading east through the hall. You will encounter a Fanged Imp at the end of the hallway. You can safely drop, then head north. In the northernmost wall, you can pick up x1 Grave Glovewort [4] from a dead body. Head back south going down the ramps, and you'll find another lift which leads you to a boss fog.

Once you head inside the boss fog, you will encounter Jori, Elder Inquisitor. For a more detailed guide on how to defeat Jori, Elder Inquisitor, you can visit this page. After defeating Jori, Elder Inquisitor, you will obtain the Barbed Staff-Spear and the Forsaken Graveyard Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map will be unlocked. When you're done here, you will now head to the Abyss by entering through the new are you just unlocked.

  • See the next tab for the Abyssal Woods. Click here to return to the tab selection.


Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Walkthrough - Abyss

Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree - Navigating Abyssal Woods

  • Activate Woodlands Trail - Site of Grace
  • Obtain Map: Abyss
  • Reach Abandoned Church
  • Return to Woodlands Trail, then make your way to Abyssal Woods - Site of Grace
  • Explore Midra's Manse

NOTE: The Abyssal Woods can be accessed after defeating the boss of the Darklight Catacombs. You can follow the path going south to get to the Abyssal Woods region. If you haven't reached this location, you can follow the #15 of the Game Progress Route or Shadow Keep Underground (Main Gate and Recluse River) and follow the guide to clear Darklight Catacombs.

After defeating Jori, Elder Inquisitor, you will unlock an entrance to the Abyssal Woods. First, activate the Forsaken Graveyard - Site of Grace that spawned after the fight then head through the archway and head south. NOTE: Down here, Torrent can't be summoned because it is terrified, and you will be walking on foot. Continue heading south until you see another Site of Grace as soon as you formally enter the region. You can see it right in front of the thick tree. Use the Woodlands Trail - Site of Grace.

From there, head south and follow the dirt path. You will pass through some creatures here and skeleton enemies. As soon as you see the elevated thick tree, turn left and you will be heading east this time. You know that you are in the right place if you can spot the church-like structure from a distance. Along the trail, you will encounter a hostile NPC, the Madding Hand (NPC) who drops the Madding Hand weapon if you kill the NPC. Continue along the path until you reach the pillar and the Abandoned Church. The map is right in front of this building so make sure to pick up Map: Abyss first. This will help you navigate the area easily.

Abandoned Church

  • Inside the abandoned church, you can find x2 Scadutree Fragment in front of the altar.
  • Check the north side interior of the church to find a body sitting against the wall. Loot the corpse to acquire x1 Frenzyflame Perfume Bottle.

Midra's Manse

NOTE: The enemies there with the orange glowing heads cannot be damaged with normal weaponry so it's recommended to sneak when you come across them. Stick to the edges and crouch low until you get out of their zones.

Return to the Woodland Trail - Site of Grace and then face the west direction. Jump down the platform and follow the river here. Keep walking towards the west until you reach the Abyssal Woods - Site of Grace. Head north and go towards the tall archway at the far end. After the archway, face the western direction and keep walking. Watch out for the enemies patrolling here. At the end, you will see a waterfall and Divided Falls - Site of Grace.

Backtrack a little and go under the bridge to the southeast. You can see 2 enemies here but you can try to fight them, or outrun them. Then, jump down and turn right. Look for a ramp to your left and climb it by jumping between the stones. Stick to the right wall and then jump down again.

You will see a building in the distance to the south and this is the Midra's Manse. You will find the door here directly on your south if you stick to the right wall. As you enter the room, a voice can be heard asking you to leave.

In this room, you can turn right to find a room with a dead body containing x1 Swollen Grape. The stairs going up will lead you to the Manse Hall Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map. The door on the west side of the hall will be locked, so hit the painting opposite of it to reveal a hidden hallway.

Proceed through the hallway, and you will find a room on your left. Enter the room, then pick up x1 Torn Diary Page on a dead body. The room will be filled with Shadow Undead, which you can easily deal with as they die in one or two hits. You can then climb up the bookshelves through the southeastern corner of the room, then head to the tallest bookshelf to obtain x2 Swollen Grape. Head back out the hallway through either of the two doorways in the room.

After heading out, you will encounter a Horned Warrior patrolling around the hallway. Once you have dealt with the Horned Warrior, you can follow the hallway going east, then going around the corner to find another room. Enter the room filled with Shadow Undead, along with a Shadow Undead above using the incantation The Flame of Frenzy on you. You can pick up x4 Thin Beast Bones on a body by the fireplace.

Head to the archway leading to another room, and you will encounter another Horned Warrior patrolling the room. You can sneak past the Horned Warrior as its pathing will only be in the direction it is facing. Follow the room going southwest, and a Shadow Undead will be waiting for you around the corner. The Shadow Undead will try to get a jump on you, so attack it right as you are going around the corner. After dealing with the Shadow Undead, head to the room opposite of it, then pull the lever.

After pulling the lever, follow the room on the east, hugging the wall, and you will find a ladder going up. You'll end up in a room with Shadow Undead scattered around. You can pick up x1 Shadow Realm Rune [6] from a dead body hanging by a beam. Head to the next room, which will be the balcony that the Shadow Undead using Flame of Frenzy on you is located. x3 Surging Frenzied Flame will be on the southwestern section of the balcony. Next, head up the ladder on the northern wall of the room.

At the upper level, you will be walking across beams. As you traverse through the beams, there will be Frenzied Giant Rats on the right archway that might attack you. If you enter the dark room the rats are in, you can loot x1 Mad Craftsman's Cookbook [3]. Keep heading west, and you will arrive at the Midra's Library Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map.

Midra's Library

Head west of the Site of Grace, and you will be in the library. You will encounter frenzied enemies throughout the library. On your left, you can cross a beam to get on top of the library shelves. On the shelf in the middle, you can grab x1 Golden Horn Tender from a dead body. You can drop down to another shelf, which contains x1 Shadow Realm Rune [7]. Drop down the shelf, then go to the eastern side to find a door.

Open the door to gain access to a shortcut to Manse Hall. After opening the door, look at the southern wall with the painting just before the previously closed door. Attack it to reveal another hidden path. This leads to a lever that you can pull to move a bookshelf, opening up another path.

Backtrack your way to the bookshelf where you obtained a Golden Horn Tender. Instead of dropping down again, jump on the ledge north of it. Follow the path, crossing the run-down path. Make the jump to get to a balcony with a dead body, in which you can loot x1 Nanaya's Torch.

On the recently opened path, head up the stairs. You can pick up x2 Swollen Grape from a dead body just before the path. You will be in a room on the upper level of the library, along with a Greater Inquisitor in the area which drops a Revered Spirit Ash. After defeating the Inquisitor, head up another set of stairs on the east. Keep following the path, clearing the room of the Inquisitors, and you will discover the Second Floor Chamber Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map.

Head north of the Site of Grace, and you will see a chandelier along with a ladder going down. Kick the ladder down before jumping to the chandelier to obtain x1 Revered Spirit Ash. You can drop down safely to the ground without receiving any damage. Climb up the ladder you just kicked to the Second Floor Chamber Site of Grace, then go directly east of it through the archway. You will hear a person wailing in the room nearby. Approach the wailing man, and it will be hostile towards you. Defeat the enemy, and it will trigger a cutscene.

Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame

After defeating the wailing man, it will then be revealed in the cutscene that he is Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame. You will then fight the true form of Midra, the embodiment of the Frenzied Flame. He will be using a spear made out of the weapon that was formerly impaling him. For a more detailed guide on how to defeat Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame, you can refer to this guide.

After defeating Midra, you will receive the Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame and the Discussion Chamber Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map will be unlocked.

  • See the next tab for the Shadow Keep (Main). Click here to return to the tab selection.

Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Walkthrough - Shadow Keep (Main)

Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Shadow Keep - A Legacy Dungeon

  • Return to Main Gate Plaza - Site of Grace
  • Head back out through the southeast doorway and go inside the main building in the northern direction
  • Use Storehouse, First Floor - Site of Grace
  • Find your way to West Rampart - Site of Grace then return to the first floor of Storehouse (you will use this later after defeating the main boss of Shadow Keep)
  • Speak with Sir Ansbach
  • Obtain Secret Rite Scroll
  • Use Storehouse, Seventh Floor - Site of Grace
  • Speak with Redmane Freyja
  • Progress both NPC questlines by giving the scroll to Sir Ansbach, informing him about Redmane Freyja and give the Letter to Freyja to Redmane. (Use teleporter and exhaust both of their dialogues to receive the Golden Lion Shield from Freyja)
  • Use the switch found on the 6th floor to switch the ceiling statues
  • Return to the first floor and jump between the newly moved statues to reach an upper area
  • Use the Dark Chamber Entrance - Site of Grace NOTE: Before going inside, make sure you have progressed Needle Knight Leda and Hornsent questline. Hornsent's quest can get bricked if you trigger Messmer's cutscene by going inside his room. In our playthrough, we progressed this after entering through the Main Gate for the first time. See #15 of the Game Progress or Shadow Keep Underground (Main Gate and Recluse River).
  • Fight Messmer the Impaler (It's important to summon Hornsent during the fight for his questline)
  • Return to Hornsent Grandam in Belurat Tower Settlement (You will receive one final item from her)
  • Teleport to West Rampart - Site of Grace
  • Cross the bridge to reach the Ancient Ruins of Rauh

MAIN PLAZA CONTINUATION

After arriving in the Main Gate Plaza, use the shortcut you just opened then go up the ramp, in which you'll be surrounded by four Shadow Militiamen. After arriving at the top of the ramp, you can head up the stairs. You can pick up x8 Bone Dart from a corpse by the stairs. A Fire Knight will be waiting across the bridge. As you are walking to the Fire Knight, pick up the x8 Smithing Stone [2] from the dead body. The Fire Knight uses slow wide swings when attacking, so you can attack or even stagger it after dodging one attack.

After defeating the Fire Knight, you can go through the big archway it was previously patrolling, which leads to a lift. Use the lift to go up, and you will end up in the Storehouse, First Floor Site of Grace [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Elden Ring Map]]].

SHADOW KEEP: SPECIMEN STOREHOUSE

STOREHOUSE, FIRST FLOOR (DETOUR)

On the west side of the First Floor Site of Grace, you'll find a room filled with Shadow Undead, along with a dead body sitting against the stone tablets containing x1 Rune Arc. Head inside the room, and you will find a lift which you can ride going down.

After arriving at the bottom of the lift, you will be in a room connecting two other rooms. In the room west, you will find a corpse that you can loot for x1 Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot along with a Living Jar hiding by the entrance of the room. The second room is a hallway, which also connects two more rooms. The room on the left will have a Living Jar by the door along with a corpse sitting by the railing containing the Ash of War: Wall of Sparks.

In the northern room, you'll find a Living Jar running up the stairs. Defeat the Living Jar, but don't go down the stairs yet. Go to the hallway beside the stairs, then hit the Illusory wall to reveal a hidden room. You can obtain x1 Battlefield Priest's Cookbook (4). After obtaining the cookbook, you can now head down the stairs.

You will find yourself in a room filled with Living Jars. After dealing with the Living Jars, go west to find a corpse containing x5 Hefty Beast Bone behind a jar. Head south to get into another room filled with more Living Jars. On the eastern side, you'll find a Living Jar standing in front of an item. Defeat the Living Jar and two more small Living Jars, then loot the item to receive the Iris of Grace - an item you can hand over to an NPC later. You'll also find a dead corpse lying on a bed southwest of the Iris of Grace which contains x1 Hefty Cracked Pot.

After clearing the room, head west to enter a room. Be cautious as you are entering the room, as a Living Jar will attack you on the right side. Head down either staircase, as they both lead to the same area. This room leads outside to the West Rampart Site of Grace [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Elden Ring Map]]], which is another entrance to the Shadow Keep. Travel back to the Storehouse, First Floor Site of Grace to resume exploring the Shadow Keep.

EXPLORING THE SPECIMEN STOREHOUSE, FIRST FLOOR

As soon as you arrive on the first floor, head east to find a dead corpse containing x1 Fireproof Pickled Liver. Afterwards, head west, passing by the archway instead of going inside the room. You'll find a path by the base of the specimen in the middle of the room going northeast. You will encounter numerous Shadow Undead and Shadow Militiamen on the first floor of the Specimen Storehouse. Keep following the path, and you'll a staircase going to the left, along with an Undead Shadow in the middle of it.

Go up the stairs, and you'll find yourself in a big room filled with bookcases. The northern side will be a dead-end, but it will have a corpse that you can loot for x1 Fire Coil.

Head northwest of it, and you will find a room that has x3 Hefty Beast Bone on a corpse lying against a table with a specimen. In this room, you will find Ansbach on the northeastern corner of the room reading a scripture. Talk to him, and exhaust all of Ansbach's dialogues. Head back out of the room, then follow the path going northwest. Turn right on the first one, and you'll find two Shadow Undead reading books, along with a hostile Shadow Undead and a Vulgar Militiaman at the base of a staircase.

After dealing with the enemies, you can keep exploring the west side of the first floor wherein you'll find a Fire Knight patrolling around a big bookcase. You can get a jump on the Fire Knight as you can easily backstab it. On the southern side of the bookcase, you'll find a corpse containing x5 Smithing Stone [8]. After looting the corpse, you can now head up the stairs.

SPECIMEN STOREHOUSE, SECOND FLOOR

After getting on top of the stairs, go up the smaller set of steps on the left side. On the west side, you'll find a corpse containing x4 Black Pyrefly sitting against a table. Head down the small set of steps, then follow the path. Once the path forks out, follow the path on the right. At the end of the path, you can find x3 Smithing Stone [5] on a dead body by the railing on the right.

Once you have picked up the smithing stone, you can drop down the railing opposite of it. You'll be in a room with a corpse containing the Boltdrake Talisman +3. On the northwestern wall, you can pull a lever that opens a hidden path back to the first floor near the Site of Grace. You'll find x2 Ember of Messmer on the dead body you'll find immediately after the path opens. Backtrack your way to the stairs going up, then head left again.

Before going up the stairs going to the third floor, you can find a Fire Knight on the section underneath it. Defeat the Fire Knight, then pick up x4 Beast Horn on the dead body next to it. You can then head up the stairs going to the third floor.

SPECIMEN STOREHOUSE, THIRD FLOOR

Once you go up the stairs, you'll find a Fire Knight by the southwestern side looking over the ledge. Defeat the Fire Knight first to make it easier to explore the third floor. NOTE: Take note of this location, as you'll have to backtrack to this location after a certain event. Afterwards, you are free to explore the floor as it is only filled with numerous Shadow Undead. On the south side of the third floor, you can loot x1 Blessed Bone Shard on a dead body sitting against books.

On the western side of the third floor, you'll find a room filled with Shadow Undead reading scriptures. You'll also find a Fire Knight on the southwestern side of the room. After defeating the Fire Knight, you can loot a corpse near the Fire Knight's position for x1 Beast Horn.

Head back out of the room, then go up the area with railings. Cross the bridge on the south side. Along the bridge, you can loot a dead body for x1 Furlcalling Finger Remedy. Two Shadow Militiamen will attack you as you approach the end of the bridge. Look east near the end of the bridge, and you will find an area you can jump onto from the railings. On the southern wall, you'll find x1 Dueling Shield on a dead body by the wall. Return to the path, then go southwest.

You'll find a room containing more Shadow Undead. In the first room, you'll find x2 Lump of Flesh on a dead body by the wall on the northern side. Head to the second room, and you'll find another Fire Knight patrolling around a bookcase. Backstab the Fire Knight, then finish it off. On the eastern side of the room, you can find a dead body containing x4 Beast Horn sitting against the railing.

Return to the bridge, then jump up to the feet of the hanging specimen. If you want to find more loot, you can jump down to the specimen below to get x1 Revered Spirit Ash. If you jumped down, make your way back up to the bridge, then jump up again on the feet of the hanging specimen. This time, make your way up to the head of the specimen, then jump to the fourth floor.

SPECIMEN STOREHOUSE, FOURTH FLOOR

After jumping onto the fourth floor, you can loot x1 Scadutree Fragment and a Storehouse Cross Message in the middle of the room. Activate the Storehouse, Fourth Floor Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map, then you can resume your exploration of the Shadow Keep.

After activating the Site of Grace, head west to go outside. On the right side, you can find x3 Stormhawk Feather on a dead body near the ledge. Afterwards, head south, then go up the stairs. On the next set of stairs, a Fire Knight will be aggressive towards you, casting spells from afar. Before going up the stairs, you can loot a corpse on the right side of the stairs for x4 Black Pyrefly. After defeating the Fire Knight, follow the path until you find a staircase going down. Defeat the Giant Bats near the top of the stairs, then go down the stairs. On the ledge by the stairs, you can find a corpse with x1 Shadow Realm Rune [5].

After looting the dead body, head inside the room, which is another section of the fourth floor. On the northeastern side, behind the bookshelf, you can find x1 Secret Rite Scroll - an item that you need for a quest later involving Ansbach and Redmane Freyja. On the south side of the room near the entrance, you can loot a corpse for x1 Holyproof Pickled Liver. Head back out of the room, then continue following the path. Near the end of the path, you'll find a room on the left side. Before entering it, defeat the Giant Bat at the end of the path, then loot the dead body by the ledge for x3 Ember of Messmer. After looting the corpse, you can head inside the room, which will be the fifth floor of the Specimen Storehouse.

SPECIMEN STOREHOUSE, FIFTH FLOOR

On the western partition of the fifth floor, you will encounter three Shadow Undead in the area. Defeat the enemies, then loot the body on the western wall for x2 Smithing Stone [6].

Afterwards, keep going in the northeast direction, clearing the path of the Shadow Undead that you encounter. You can find x2 Fire Coil on a corpse by a lectern between a bookshelf along the way. Keep following the path, eventually going north, and you will encounter another Fire Knight. Near the Fire Knight, you can find x3 Smithing Stone [7] on a corpse resting by the wall on the right. Continue following the path, and you will eventually get to the stairs leading to the sixth floor. Head up the stairs, and you'll find x1 Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot on a corpse near the top of the stairs.

SPECIMEN STOREHOUSE, SIXTH FLOOR

After arriving at the sixth floor, go to the room on the south. In this room, you will encounter three Shadow Undead along with a Fire Knight with its back turned against you. After defeating the enemies, you can loot a dead body near the Fire Knight for x1 Spirit Calculus. Head back out of the room, and another Fire Knight patrolling the area will approach you. Deal with the Fire Knight, then head up the stairs to get to the seventh floor.

SPECIMEN STOREHOUSE, SEVENTH FLOOR

On the seventh floor, you can find a corpse containing x2 Sliver of Meat sitting by the rail near the stairs. Go to the room on the southwest, then activate the Storehouse, Seventh Floor Site of Grace [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Elden Ring Map]]]. In this room, you can find Redmane Freyja on the other end reading a stone tablet. Talk to her, and exhaust all of her dialogues - this is part of a quest. After talking to Redmane Freyja, go back to the Storehouse, First Floor Site of Grace.

ANSBACH AND FREYJA

After arriving at the first floor, backtrack your way to Ansbach. Talk to him, then hand over the Secret Rite Scroll you found earlier to him. Keep talking to him until you get the prompt to tell him about Freyja's decision. Click on it, then Ansbach will give you the Letter for Freyja after talking to him. Go to the seventh floor, then give the Letter for Freyja to Redmane Freyja. She will then give you the Golden Lion Shield after talking to her one more time.

SHADOW KEEP EXPLORATION

Head out of the room, then head to the northeastern section of the seventh floor. Defeat the Fire Knight in this section, then head southeast to find a specimen that you can jump on to by the railing. You can find x1 Revered Spirit Ash on the back of the specimen.

Afterwards, head to the eastern room on the sixth floor. You will encounter numerous Shadow Undead in this area, along with a corpse that you can loot for x1 Shadow Realm Rune [5]. On the southern wall, you can find a lever on a platform. Pull the lever, and the mechanism in the middle will move up, also moving up the specimens hanging on it.

OBTAINING THE PEARLDRAKE TALISMAN

After the specimens have moved, make your way back to the area with the Fire Knight on the third floor (See note here). On the western side of the railing, you can find the Pearldrake Talisman +3 on a specimen that has moved up.

HEADING DEEPER INTO THE SHADOW KEEP

Go back to the Storehouse, Seventh Floor Site of Grace, then go down to the sixth floor. Go to the lever room on the east, then jump on to the beam in the middle. Make your way up the specimens, climbing onto the one with the horn. Cross it, then jump to a balcony across the horn on the west side. You will be in a room full of creatures and Shadow Undead.

Head out the room by going through the archway west of the room, then follow the path going north. Head up the stairs, and you'll find a room on the right, and a Fire Knight on the left guarding a door. Head inside the room first. In the room, you will encounter three Shadow Undead here, along with a corpse that you can loot for x3 Ember of Messmer. After clearing the room, head out then defeat the Fire Knight across the bridge. This Fire Knight is different than the rest of the Fire Knights you have found throughout exploring the Shadow Keep, as its attacks are more aggressive compared to the normal Fire Knights. Defeating this Fire Knight will give you the Winged Serpent Helm and Ash of War: Flame Spear.

Open the door across the bridge, then pick up the Scadutree Fragment directly in front of you. Head up the stairs, then activate the Dark Chamber Entrance Site of Grace [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Elden Ring Map]]] at the top. Be prepared for a boss fight, as opening the door next to the Site of Grace will lead you to the boss of the Shadow Keep.

OBTAINING THE IMPENETRABLE THORNS

After activating the Dark Chamber Entrance Site of Grace, you'll want to retrace your steps as to obtain the Impenetrable Thorns sorcery. Return to the bridge where you fought Kood, Captain of the Fire Knights, then cross it to the other side. Head down the first set of staircases, where you will encounter two Shadow Undead patrolling as you explore the area. You will then find a Shadow Undead overlooking the ledge. Defeat the Shadow Undead, then look down the ledge to see a platform wherein you can safely drop. After you drop to the platform, defeat the Giant Bat that you will encounter immediately after dropping. You will then see a dead body sitting against the wall nearby which you can then loot for the Impenetrable Thorns sorcery. You can then return to the Dark Chamber Entrance Site of Grace to progress through the Shadow Keep.

THE DARK CHAMBER

IMPORTANT: Starting Messmer the Impaler's boss fight for the first time will make the summon signs for aiding/invading Hornsent disappear (through the shortcut door, at the top of the ramp from the Main Gate Plaza grace) so make sure to complete that if you desire to complete Hornsent/Needle Knight Leda's questline. If you choose to invade Hornsent and help Needle Knight Leda, you should also go back to Sir Ansbach's location near the Storehouse, First Floor grace and choose to aid/invade him as well (The Sir Ansbach fight will not be available if you aid Hornsent). Read up on their questlines on their respective pages for more information.

Near the Dark Chamber Entrance Site of Grace will be a door. Opening it will lead you to the boss, who is then revealed to be Messmer the Impaler. If you choose to aid Hornsent his summon sign will be inside the boss room. Messmer the Impaler uses a spear as a weapon, so be mindful of the range of his attacks. His spear and attacks will be imbued with fire, so having fire resistance would be a good idea for this boss fight. For a more in-depth guide on how to defeat Messmer the Impaler, you can go to this page for more information.

After defeating Messmer the Impaler, you will receive Messmer's Kindling along with the Remembrance of the Impaler. Messmer's Kindling will be used to gain access to a legacy dungeon, Enir-Ilim See Elden Ring Map. If you summoned Hornsent during the fight, rest at Messmer's Dark Chamber grace ONLY ONCE (any more than once and he will disappear) and exhaust his dialogue to continue his questline.

  • See the next tab for the Ancient Ruins of Rauh Walkthrough. Click here to return to the tab selection.


Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Walkthrough - Ancient Ruins of Rauh

Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree - Path to Ancient Ruins of Rauh

  • Activate Viaduct Minor Tower - Site of Grace
  • Explore the southern section
  • Head to the eastern section
  • Fight Devonia, Crucible Knight
  • Eliminate Furnace Golem
  • Continue to the western section
  • Head up the ramp and fight this NPC invader
  • Fight Romina, Saint of the Bud

Crossing the Bridge from Shadow Keep

If you have been following this walkthrough, teleport to the West Rampart - Site of Grace in Shadow Keep. If you haven't unlocked this section, please see Shadow Keep or the Shadow Keep (Main) Tab on this page for the full walkthrough on how to reach the area.

From the Site of Grace, enter through the small archway on the right side of the bridge. It is recommended to ride Torrent here as you cross the bridge so you can move faster and loot as you travel. There will be giant bats on this bridge but you will move fast enough and they shouldn't be able to reach you. You will find lootable corpses here, the first one to the left which is a Smithing Stone [3]. Up ahead, you can loot more 3x Beast Liver, 3x Beast Blood, Smithing Stone [4], 5x Redflesh Mushroom, 8x Thin Beast Bones, and a Somber Smithing Stone [2].

At the other end of this bridge, you will encounter a Fire Knight wearing a red cloak. It wields dual daggers and can cast fire magic and will drop Salza's Hood and Rain of Fire upon defeating it.

Go inside the building behind the enemy you just defeated and take the Somber Smithing Stone [9] from the corpse on the corner. Take the spiral stairs next to it and you will reach an elevator at the top. This will take you to a new gate and then, interact with the Viaduct Minor Tower - Site of Grace here.

Exploring the Southern Area

  • The southern area of the Ancient Ruins of Rauh covers exploring the parts near the Site of Grace. This includes the area below you that is accessible via the elevator in the small pond.

Go through the archway and go to the right side. Stick to the wall and go ride past the thick greenery here. You will go around this building and at the back, you can pick up the Golden Horn Tender. Go back the same way you came from, return to the entrance side, and head southeast past the small pond. You can see some boar creatures hanging out here and go behind this tree. Look for the corpse lying on top of a stone slab and pick up the Spirit Calculus. Then, use the elevator to go down to the lower level.

As you go down, face the southwest direction so you are ready for the Bloodfiend waiting here. Then, follow the path behind it where a group of Bloodfiends is gathered. This can be difficult since you are outnumbered, but if you have a magic build, you can use Adula's Moonblade to effectively take out the group. After fighting them, you can pick up Somber Smithing Stone [8] from the corpse behind the group. From here, face the southwest direction and exit through the small hole. Go to the right side and go past the bloodfiend. There's a corpse near the edge and you can pick up 8x Thin Beast Bones from it.

Now look behind you; you should be facing southeast here and go towards the edge and jump down on the steps below you. Look to your right and fight the Hippopotamus. This looks just like the boss at the Main Entrance of Shadow Keep but this one has a smaller health pool. It can also pull off the same moves just like the boss version. Upon defeating it, it will drop a Scadutree Fragment. You are now done with this section. Return to the Site of Grace and continue exploring the eastern area through the felled tree.

Eastern Section

Upon exiting the archway, face the western direction and go through the collapsed tree. Follow the path ahead where you will see small creatures and make a right to to enter the building marked by these 2 standing lanterns. This area is filled with shadowy enemies and there are variations of them. Others are hunched on the ground, while there are some walking around carrying a jar. Take note that some of these enemies carry an important item. If you see them glimmering in the dark, eliminate them to take their item.

As you enter, go to your immediate right and climb up the overgrown roots. Head towards the northeast and turn left behind the pillar to pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [9] from the edge of this root. Go around this area and return to the entrance side and eliminate the Shadowpot here. This one is carrying a Revered Spirit Ash and a Silver Horn Tender. Pick it up later after you fight the Curseblade. This behaves similarly to the boss but has a lesser health pool. After defeating these enemies, face the northeast where you see this tall door.

Don't enter through the door yet, instead turn left and you will see this burning cauldron. You can pick up the Fire Spritestone on the right side of this cauldron. Then, return to the door but make sure to defeat the nearby enemies here so they can't interrupt you. Open up the door and head down the steps. You will be fighting a Giant Scorpion here, then turn left where you will fight more of these Giant Scorpions. You can pick up the Shadow Realm Rune [5] just past this lit stone.

After picking up this item, look behind you and attack this illusory wall. Go inside and pick up the Bondstone and Antiquity Scholar's Cookbook (2). Leave this area and turn right to progress. Go down the steps where a group of Shadow Undead are gathered. Pay attention to the glimmering one carrying a jar and make sure to eliminate them to get 3x Spirit Calculus from them. You can also pick up a Broken Rune in front of this square hole to the southeast. (Take note of this location because you will be coming back here later)

Go through this square hole and once you reach the other side, you will be fighting more Giant Scorpions. Watch out for the ones hiding and sleeping on the ceiling. They will attack you as you approach this loot on the corner. Go up the stones and take the Somber Smithing Stone (6) from the corpse here. Exit this area and turn right. Look for this glimmering enemy carrying a jar and defeat it. It will drop a Scadutree Fragment and Golden Horn Tender.

Then, look behind you and face the northeast direction. You will be able to see a Curseblade on the second pillar. This one will not go down unless you go near it, so you can just use range attacks to defeat it without getting damaged. After killing it, walk in front of you and pick up the 5x Throwing Dagger on the next alcove.

From the last alcove, turn right, then left. You will be facing a group of Shadow Undead and a giant scorpion here. Make sure to take them out before you continue exploring here. Loot the corpse here to get x1 Glass Shard. Continue up ahead and turn right to this room where you see a scorpion suspended in the air. You can see multiple corpses on the ground with loot on them but you need to eliminate this enemy first. Try not to the aggro of the Giant Scorpion on the other by doing ranged attacks. After doing so, pick up the x2 Sliver of Meat, x3 Scorpion Liver, and Spider Scorpion Ashes.

Head to the next area filled with white flowers and defeat the Giant Scorpions here. You can also pick up 2x Dewgem from the corpse here. Then, return to the other side of the square hole that you entered earlier. Trace your steps and return to the area where the Shadow Undead are gathered. Open the door here facing southwest, then, take the 5x Rauh Burrow from the corpse to your right.

Follow this path until you reach this Spiritspring with surrounding nails. You can jump down here while riding Torrent and you will not be damaged. Face the southeast direction and go to the very end of this path. Pick up the Shadow Realm Rune (6) behind the Spiritspring. Don't go up the spiritspring and head back towards the area where you came from.

Turn right behind the 3rd pillar, and then go up the thick roots to pick up the Fine Crucible Feather Talisman. Then, head southwest and exit through the small archway at the end. Turn left and you will see an item on the top of the first archway to your left. Behind it, you can use the overgrown branch to climb this arch and then pickup the Shadow Realm Rune (7) from the corpse. Continue riding southeast and you will reach the outdoor area.

When this enemy comes into view, don't try to take its aggro right away. You want to be able to reach the nearby Site of Grace here by walking only on the right side. Stick to the edge on your right and you will see Miquella's Cross here near the edge. The Rauh Ancient Ruins, East - Site of Grace is on your right and you can pick up an Ancient Ruins Cross Message and Scadutree Fragment on the ground near the cross.

From the Site of Grace, face northeast and go towards the pillar here. Walk over the edge to find an item near the waterfall. Pick up the Ash of War: Dryleaf Whirlwind here. Then, return to the enemy that you saw earlier. This Lesser Crucible Knight will drop Devonia's Hammer and Crucible Hammer-Helm upon defeating it.

After defeating this enemy, cross the bridge facing southwest. There's a Furnace Golem at the other end of this bridge and it will start attacking you as you jump down. There are also Shadow Undead along the way and you can pick up 4x Dewgem and 2x Flight Pinion. Then, jump down to the right side here. Ride up ahead but make sure to sprint so you can safely reach the covered area here. Then, go past the Furnace Golem, and don't fight it for now. The Rauh Ancient Ruins, West - Site of Grace is in the area behind it so you want to get the checkpoint first.

The Western Section Part 1

From the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West - Site of Grace, go down the ramp and fight the Furnace Golem. It will drop the Crimson-Sapping Cracked Tear and a Furnace Visage upon defeating it.

After fighting the Furnace Golem, teleport to the Site that you had just activated. Face the southwest direction and go toward the double archway. There are different Shadow Undead here, like shadow mage and shadow hound. Eliminate them as you go and go up the stairs to the right. You can pick up a 6x Kukri on the steps and Redflesh Mushroom from the enemies.

Go up the steps, then, go to the right side and eliminate the glimmering Shadowpot here. It will drop x3 Spirit Calculus and a Rauh Burrow. Then, defeat the 2 Shadow Mages here. At the center of this map, there's a Curseblade. This one uses death spells and is just as dangerous as the boss version. On the northwest side, there's an altar where Shadow Undead are worshipping. Go towards it and pick up the Scadutree Fragment.

Then, explore towards south and then turn right. Make sure to pick up the Rauh Burrow and 2x Spiritgrave Stone along the way. Then, use the elevator at the end of this path that will take you to the stone pillar section. Go to the left then jump down on the stone pillar below you. Try to land on the widest portion here and follow the steps 1 to 3. When you get to the 3rd jump, look to the pillar behind you and pick up the Four-Toed Fowl Foot from the corpse.

Keep following the steps here and then face southeast and jump towards the building on the far end to the left. Eliminate the 2 enemies holding a candlestick standing in front of the steps here. Face the building and go towards the square hole to the left, then turn left again to reach the chest. You can get the Talisman of All Crucibles inside.

The Grand Stairway Section

While facing the chest, exit through the square hole to your right. Use the elevator to go up, and you can already see the Ancient Ruins, Grand Stairway - Site of Grace from the top. Walk towards it and activate it.

Face the northwest direction, jump down the stairs, and then turn right to get loot. Stick to the wall to your right and then go to the very edge here to pick up a Spirit Calculus from a corpse. Then, return to the grand stairway where you see the archer version of the Golem Warrior. You can go up the ramp behind it and take it out. This enemy is weak to heavy attacks so make sure to take full advantage of its weakness.

Go down the broken bridge here and cross towards the northeast. Near the end of this bridge, you will find a corpse in the middle and you can take a Shadow Realm Rune (7) from it. If you look down to the right, there's a Divine Beast Dancing Lion field boss here - please read ahead before jumping down! It's up to you if you want to fight it head-on but if you ended up jumping down to its level, you can run away from it by jumping down yet again on the northeastern platform. This disables the fight and the boss will not chase you. Oddly enough, this field boss can also be sniped from the bridge you're on from above. Fair warning, it will spawn basilisks onto the bridge but this is the biggest threat you'll encounter and it is easily defeated using this method. After defeat it drops the Divine Beast Tornado Incantation.

After the Dancing Lion fight head northeast and jump down off the platform. There's an elite enemy in the middle of the pool. This one wields dual curved swords and has a chance to drop pieces of the Divine Bird Set upon defeating it. Go up the ramp on the left side to pick up 2x Beast Bones. Then, go to the area behind the boss to pick up Verdigris Discus. Continue exploring the southern area here to pick up a Redflesh Mushroom from a corpse next to a pillar. This is your last stop in the Grand Stairway section and you will now return to the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West - Site of Grace.

The Western Section Part 2

  • This covers the rest of the exploration of the western section where you will be invaded by an NPC.

From the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West - Site of Grace, face the southwest section and climb up the stairs to the left. This is the same area that you explore earlier but instead of going to the left section, you will head northwest towards the outdoor area. Head straight into the gazebo in front of you and you can pick up the Revered Spirit Ash on this altar. Watch out for the enemy nearby but since you are riding Torrent, you can just outrun them.

Continue exploring the path behind this gazebo and make sure to pick up this Rauh Burrow on the wall. Take note of the location on your left because you will be returning here later. For now, continue ahead and jump down on the platform behind this stone.

Go to the bottom of the steps and head northeast. You will find hounds inflicted with Scarlet rot here and you can pick up Golden Horn Tender from this corpse in the middle. There's a Bloodfiend here in the middle of this section but it's up to you if you want to fight it. You can get 5x Sacred Bloody Flesh if you want to fight it. Continue traveling north where you will encounter another Bloodfiend, then turn left where more enemies are waiting. Take out the hounds and bloodfiends here for a chance to get Beast Blood and a piece of the bloodfiend's gear, like Bloodfiend's Fork.

On the upper area, while facing northwest, you will see this glimmering Shadowpot. To go there, you need to head to jump down on the area below it. Summon Torrent and try to land on the highest part here to minimize your fall damage. The elevator is right here when you go down, but before that, make sure to head to the area on the northeast. This area is protected by giant flies, so you need to eliminate them first.

Take the Somber Smithing Stone (1) from the corpse lying on the stone. After doing so, head east where you see the Pink Flowerbloom. Go towards it and then pick up the Aspects of the Crucible: Bloom. Now, return to where you jumped down and take the elevator to go up. On the top level, you will reach a Shadowpot which drops a Revered Spirit Ash. You can then eliminate the nearby enemies to get a Redflesh Mushroom and Silver Horn Tender.

This is your last stop in this area and you will now be returning to the area that we mentioned that you will be coming back to. Jump down on the same ledge that you are facing as you approached the loot, then look behind this pillar and you will see a corpse here. Take the 3x Knot Resin from it then go up the stairs.

Turn right where you will be facing scarlet rot-inflicted enemies. There's a scarlet version of Lesser Kindred of Rot (Pests) here, be careful of them because they can deal a high amount of damage when you get struck by them.

Go to the northwest arch and pick up the Dappled White Cured Meat. To your right, there are more pest enemies here. There's a large group of them in the next section and try to cheese them as much as you can. If you have any ranged or magic attacks, make use of them to eliminate them before they get near you. You can obtain these items from the ground here: x3 Immunizing Cured Meat, x4 Fly Mold, and x8 Smithing Stone (2). After fighting them, exit through the archway on the left side. Look on the stack of stones to your right and you will see a corpse here. You can pick up the Greater Potentate's Cookbook (9) from it.

Face the tower to the northeast and walk straight towards it. This is the Unseen Bridge that connects the main building to this tower. Cross to the other side and interact with the altar: if you have the Stone-Sheathed Sword, you can use it on this altar and it will turn into the Sword of Light.

Go back to the main building the same way you got here and then continue exploring by going to the left past the room. Then, turn right to use the elevator that will take you to the upper level. There are more pest enemies here at the top and you will see the stairs in the middle. Just take note of these areas for now because you will be returning here later.

First, turn your attention to the nearest enemy standing next to the archway then go out to the area outside. Go past the gazebo and look at the corpse in the middle of the water. Go towards it and then pick up the Divine Bird Feathers.

The elite enemy here will be aggro-ed upon picking up the item. Take your time as you deal with it and use the pillars of the gazebo to defend yourself against some of its attacks. After fighting it, go up the ramp and go to the edge. You will see the clusters of stones that unlock a Spiritspring after destroying it.

Jump towards the Spiritspring, then use it again to reach the area on the other side. Go to the right side and walk to the area behind the thick pillar and go around it to pick up x2 Beast Horn from the corpse. Then, go up the stairs that you saw earlier and open the chest at the top to get Mottled Necklace +2. Use the Spiritspring again to return to the other side. Head back inside where you used the elevator and then turn left.

Fight the pests that you will come across here and then turn right at the end. You can pick up the Pest-Thread Spears next to the wall on your right side. Go around this area and get ready for a fight before you head up the stairs. As you approach the top section, Hornsent will invade you. This is potentially a long walk back if you didn't activate the Spiritspring beforehand, but if you have been following this walkthrough, you will have a faster way of reaching this area in case you die.

The Spiritspring is located just northwest of the Site of Grace, in the pool area. Defeating Hornsent here will reward you with the following items:

  • Falx
  • Caterpillar Mask
  • Braided Cord Robe
  • Braided Arm Wraps
  • Soiled Loincloth

Fight Romina in the Church of the Bud

Romina, Saint of the Bud, is a mid-sized boss with a body resembling a centipede, a scorpion, the wings of a butterfly, and a human. She wields a spear, centipede fangs, and a scorpion stinger, making her a unique foe. To defeat Romina, you'll need a balanced approach, mixing both offense and defense. When facing her as a melee character, focus not only on her central human body but also observe her centipede fangs and scorpion stinger, which act as her arms.

Defeating Romina Saint of the Bud will reward you 280,000 Runes and Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud. This fight will also let you access the Sealing Tree behind the arena. You will need Messmer's Kindling to burn the Sealing Tree to gain access to the final legacy dungeon. After the short cutscene, the real Enir-Ilim will be revealed and you will be transported to the base of Enir-Ilim.

  • See the next tab for the Enir-Ilim Walkthrough. Click here to return to the tab selection.


Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Walkthrough - Enir-Ilim

Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Enir-Ilim - A Legacy Dungeon

  • Fight Needle Knight Leda and her allies.
  • Pick up all rewards.
  • Defeat the final boss.

All NPC Encounters and Fight: When youreach Needle Knight Leda's location in Enir-Ilim, you will be fighting some of Miquella's followers here. Depending on the choices that you have made so far, those who will be siding with Leda will vary. See the progression below:

  • Needle Knight Leda attacks you no matter what your choices have been.
  • Redmane Freyja: She will attack you if you gave her the Letter for Freyja from Sir Ansbach in Shadow Keep. Defeating her here will drop her items. Otherwise, she will stay in the Storehouse and will disappear to leave behind Golden Lion Shield in Shadow Keep.
  • Hornsent: Hornsent will go after you if you didn't summon him during the fight against Messmer. You will also encounter him on the way to Enir-Ilim before fighting this boss.
  • Moore: The merchant will attack you in this arena if you choose the dialogue to "Put it behind you" and then, you will be able to get his items. See his page for more info.
  • Dryleaf Dane: Just like Leda, he will attack you, no matter what your choices have been.
  • Thiollier: If you progress his quest and pass the message of St. Trina, he can be summoned as a cooperator.
  • Final Boss Fight: If you helped Ansbach and Thiollier with their quests, both of them can be summoned as cooperators.

Enir-Ilim

Legacy Dungeon
Location


Recommended Levels

150 - Above

Bosses

Promised Consort Radahn

Enir-Ilim is a Legacy Dungeon in Elden Ring. Enir-Ilim is a dungeon exclusive to the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC. You can gain access to an area containing a sealing tree by defeating Romina, Saint of the Bud in the Church of the Bud. You can then burn the sealing tree by using Messmer's Kindling, which you can obtain by defeating Messmer the Impaler. Enir-Ilim will reveal its true form after burning the sealing tree, teleporting you inside of it.

Full Enir-Ilim Walkthrough

Click here to go to the Speedrun Walkthrough.

Gaining Access to Enir-Ilim

In order to gain access to Enir-Ilim, you must first defeat Romina, Saint of the Bud who is located in the Church of the Bud See Elden Ring Map. After defeating Romina, you will unlock the Church of the Bud Site of Grace in the Ancient Ruins of Rauh, which is a few steps away from the entrance to Enir-Ilim. Head to the archway south of the Church of Bud Site of Grace, and you will find a sealing tree. When you interact with the sealing tree, it states that it cannot be burned without Messmer's kindling. This means that you have to defeat Messmer the Impaler, located in the Specimen Storehouse See Elden Ring Map, who will then drop Messmer's Kindling along with the Remembrance of the Impaler.

Arrival in Enir-Ilim

Once you have Messmer's Kindling, you can head to the sealing tree to burn it, triggering a cutscene wherein Enir-Ilim's true form is revealed. After the cutscene, you will then be teleported to Enir-Ilim.

Once you arrive in Enir-Ilim, look behind you to find a body containing x1 Somber Smithing Stone [9]. You will then discover the Enir-Ilim: Outer Wall Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map, which is right next to the spot where you were teleported.

Follow the path going east, up the stairs, in which you will see the Erdtree on the northeastern side. Keep following the path, then head up the stairs. Once you head up the stairs, a hostile Divine Bird Warrior will be approaching you. This enemy can fly, so watch out for its attacks. The staircase on the right is destroyed, so it leads to a dead-end. After dealing with the Divine Bird Warrior, head up the stairs on your left which leads to the First Rise Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map.

Exploring Around First Rise

If you go to the stairs heading up on the south side of First Rise, you will find a body that you can loot for x1 Somber Smithing Stone [5]. The staircase is destroyed, so it leads to a dead-end.

Return to the bottom of the stairs, then head to the hallway heading east-southeast of the First Rise Site of Grace. You can loot a body containing x1 Messmerfire Grease just right before the archway. Enter the room to find a lift, which you will ride going down. Go down the stairs, which then leads to Belurat, Tower Settlement See Elden Ring Map.

Heading Deeper into Enir-Ilim

Head southwest of the First Rise Site of Grace, and you will see an archway leading to a staircase going up. Go up the stairs, and you will end up in a courtyard. There will be a body on your right that you can loot for x1 Broken Rune. There is a room on the western corner of the courtyard, which you will see two Tree Shamans, one attacking you and the other praying to a tree. In the room, you will find a doorway to a staircase on the northwestern corner of the room. Follow it, and you will see another Tree Shaman. After dealing with the shaman, you can pick up x1 Rune Arc on the ground.

On the eastern side, you will find the continuation of the courtyard. A Greater Tree Shaman will be roaming around it, along with Tree Shamans praying in different corners of the courtyard. On the corner of the courtyard where shamans are praying, you can pick up x4 Budding Horn. In the middle of the courtyard, you can pick up a Revered Spirit Ash. On the northeast side of the courtyard where you killed the Greater Tree Shaman, you can pick up x2 Lightningproof Pickled Liver from the body.

Loot Detour

Head down the stairs beside the body, leading you to the base of a tree with two hostile Man-Flies. Once you have killed the two enemies, you can pick up x8 Thin Beast Bones on the dead body that the two enemies were surrounding. Northeast of the tree roots is a body that you can loot for x3 Whiteflesh Mushroom. Two Man-Flies will land on you, which you can easily deal with.

Traverse through the path on the west side of the giant tree roots. When you walk down the path, a Man-Fly will be hiding behind a root, waiting to attack you. You can find x4 Redflesh Mushroom on top of a root nearby. Straight ahead will be three Man-Flies inside a room, praying to a tree. After clearing the enemies, you can pick up x2 Revered Spirit Ash lying on the remains of a humanoid tree. Go back up the courtyard to head deeper into Enir-Ilim.

Spiral Rise Site of Grace

Once you have found yourself back in the courtyard, head up the stairs on the southeast. You will encounter a Tree Shaman on top of the stairs. After killing the Tree Shaman, keep following the path until you encounter a Divine Beast Warrior.

After dealing with the Divine Beast Warrior, you will see a platform on the northern side with a tree shaman and an item. You can drop down to the tree branches below if you want to go there. Immediately after dropping down, you can loot x3 Furlcalling Finger Remedy behind you. Cross the branches going north to get to the platform. Kill the tree shaman, then you can pick up the incantation Spira on the altar. You can then return to where you came from, then continue on from there.

Keep following the path and stairs leading up. You can pick up x1 Dragonbolt Grease on the ground, but there will be a magic attack which seems to be coming from above. Sprint up the stairs, then kill Tree Mage responsible for the flurry of magic attacks.

After dealing with the Tree Mage, you can pick up a Drawstring Golden Grease on the ledge southwest of the platform. You'll notice another Tree Mage on the rooftop of the structure, which you can deal with by using ranged attacks or incantations. A Tree Shaman will also be patrolling the area at the top of the stairs. If you don't clear the Tree Mage on the rooftop, it will keep casting spells on you as you're going up the stairs. You can sprint forward if you have no way of dealing with the Tree Mage on the rooftop. After clearing the two enemies, head up the stairs. You will find bodies that you can loot for x10 Fire Arrow and x10 Golden Bolt.

Open the door at the top of the stairs to discover Spiral Rise Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map and pick up the Scadutree Fragment nearby.

How to Get the Euporia Weapon in Elden Ring

The area just before the Spiral Rise Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map has a lot of loot that you shouldn't miss. From the Site of Grace, backtrack your way down the stairs, then turn left to find a set of steps going down. As you go through the archway, there will be a room on your right containing x1 Inquisitor Ashes. Go to the other archway just before the room, and you will see a staircase that you can drop down to that has an item.

Drop down to the stairs, and you can pick up x2 Fireproof Pickled Liver from the body. Head up the stairs, then look below the broken railings to find a ledge that you can drop down to. Look down on the southeastern section of the ledge, and you will find another area that you can drop down to.

Drop down to it, then follow the ledge going south. You'll come across a broken section going to an item. Jump to get to the other side, and you can pick up x1 Holyproof Pickled Liver. After looting it, drop down from the broken section of the ledge, then pick up the nearby item, which is x2 Smithing Stone [8].

Follow the ledge going south. Be careful as there are pillars are blocking off some parts of ledge, making it tough to navigate. Keep hugging the wall just to be safe. When you go around the corner, you will find another area that you can jump down to. Jump down the area, then traverse the ledge going southwest.

Keep following it, and you will acquire x10 Lordsworn's Bolt from a dead body at the end of it. After looting the body, follow the ledge to the other direction going down, and you'll be at a broken section of the ledge. Drop down it, and you will land near a hostile Shadow Undead. Kill it, then pick up x1 Somber Smithing Stone [5] nearby. Go down the stairs, and you'll find x1 Fireproof Pickled Liver from a dead body.

Belurat Tower Settlement Section

To progress further, sprint jump down the window south of the dead body containing x1 Fireproof Pickled Liver.

Once you have successfully jumped on the window, head inside the structure. The section you are in will be inside Belurat, Tower Settlement. Head out of the room, and you will end up in a courtyard. Kill the Spider Scorpion and pick up the a Scadutree Fragment at the base of the covered statue. There are two other rooms that you can enter from the courtyard. The room on the east has a lift that you can take to return to Enir-Ilim, while the room on the south has a lift going down Belurat, Tower Settlement. Ride down the lift in the southern room.

After taking the lift, head outside by going through the archway on the southeastern side of the room. Follow the path by going down a staircase that leads you to a room containing Inquisitor enemies. After clearing the room, follow the path going southwest. Head down the stairs, and you'll encounter a Divine Beast Warrior patrolling the area. You can either fight it head-on, or use stealth as the Divine Beast Warrior is a formidable combatant and is patrolling in a way that you can sneak around it.

After dealing with the Divine Beast Warrior with whichever method you choose, head inside the structure then go down the stairs on the western side. Go down the lift, and you will arrive in an area with a bridge crossing to a door.

Cross the bridge, then open the door. You'll find a dead body by the altar, which you can loot for the Euporia twinblade.

After obtaining the Euporia twinblade, head back to the Spiral Rise Site of Grace to continue going up Enir-Ilim.

Heading up the Spiral Rise

Head north of the room to climb up the stairs. There will be an opening on the left side of the stairs which lets you attack the Tree Mage earlier on the rooftop if you didn't get the chance to kill it. If you go back to the staircase, it will lead to a dead-end, so your only choice would be to traverse through the rooftop. Keep following the rooftop path by turning right as you exit through the opening. You'll encounter hostile large birds around the rooftop area, which you can easily dispose of. One of the birds will be hiding behind a corner, so be cautious of it. You can find x1 Smithing Stone [8] atop the roof near the part where the bird was hiding.

Keep going west until you get into an opening of a walkway. There will be another large bird guarding a room and a tree shaman patrolling the stairs. You can sneak up on the bird to easily dispose of it. Enter the room that the large bird was blocking to pick up x1 Revered Spirit Ash. Continue heading up, and if you didn't deal with the Tree Shaman earlier, it will be in this room along with another Tree Shaman. Deal with the shamans, then continue through the archway on the western side of the room and keep climbing the stairs.

As you get to the top of the stairs, you will find a room that contains x1 Scadutree Fragment lying on an altar. Keep exploring the rooftops, in which you will encounter a Divine Beast Warrior. It will use frost magic along with the greatsword they are wielding, so be cautious of those attacks. On the northeast side of the rooftop, you can loot a body to pickup x2 Sunwarmth Stone.

Another Loot Detour

If you want to find more loot, go back to where you picked up the Revered Spirit Ash. In the middle of the stairs going up, you can drop down to a set of stairs. You can find x1 Silver Horn Tender on the edge of the staircase going down. Head up the staircase, and you will end up in a room containing Horned Warrior Ashes, x2 Neutralizing Boluses, and Stanching Boluses. Backtrack your way up by climbing a ladder inside the room southwest. Head out of the ladder room, and you will find a body by the ledge containing a Golden Horn Tender. Climb up another ladder to get on the top floor of the structure, then jump off of it back into the rooftop where you fought a Divine Beast Warrior using ice spells.

Keep going by jumping up on the rooftop, and you'll find your way back to the structure of the First Rise Site of Grace, bypassing the destroyed part of the staircase. If you head down the staircase, you will find a Somber Smithing Stone [6] lying on the ground near the part where the staircase has been destroyed. If you look down the destroyed part of the stairs, you will see a platform containing an item. You can go there by jumping off of the stairs. You will get to pick up x1 Gravebird Helm if you choose to go to the platform.

After looting the platform, you can jump on a staircase on the east side of the platform. Head down the stairs, and you will find an area with a lever that when pulled down, it will bring a lift to where you currently are. There will also be a doorway leading down to an empty room with a Curseblade hiding out of sight by the other doorway. The Curseblade will be quite nimble, so be patient while you're waiting for an opening to attack it. Once you have slain the Tree Dancer, there will be a broken staircase when you go through the archway leading outside. At the end of the staircase, you can pick up x1 Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone from a dead body.

Going Up Enir-Ilim

Make your way back to where you pulled the lever then ride the lift going up. You will end up in a room with two Tree Shamans that you can easily dispose of. After clearing the room, head to the archway on the south of the room leading to a stairway going up. You will encounter a Divine Beast Warrior patrolling nearby the area, which is different from the one you encountered earlier. It uses wind attacks to complement their greatsword, and it can also swing its greatsword successively. Wait for your turn to attack it. You can even stagger it if you have enough Poise damage with your build. You will obtain the Horned Warrior's Greatsword after defeating the Divine Beast Warrior.

Cleansing Chamber Anteroom Site of Grace

After you have slain the Divine Beast Warrior, enter the structure to discover the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map. Southeast of the Site of Grace, you can pick up a Scadutree Fragment.

Encounter with Needle Knight Leda

Go through the archway on the east side of the Site of Grace, going up the stairs. Keep following the path, and you will encounter Needle Knight Leda who will invite you to challenge her and her allies. You can summon Pureblood Knight Ansbach and Thiollier to help you in this fight by interacting with the summon signs beside Leda's summon sign. During the fight, Redmane Freyja will be summoned first, followed by Hornent, then Moore, then Dryleaf Dane. You will then fight Needle Knight Leda after all the NPC invaders have been summoned.

Once you have defeated Needle Knight Leda, you will receive Leda's Sword. You can pick up the equipment of her and her allies right after returning to your world. The bodies of her allies will be lying around the place, which you can then loot. You can pick up Moore's equipment - Moore's Bell Bearing, Verdigris Greatshield, and the Verdigris Set. From Freyja, you can receive Freyja's Greatsword and Freyja's Set. Hornsent's body can be looted for Falx, Hornsent's Set, and the Soiled Loincloth. Lastly, you can receive the Dane's Set and Dane's Footwork from Dryleaf.

Head east through the archway, and you will find Needle Knight Leda's body containing Leda's Armor. After you have looted the place, head north of Needle Knight Leda's body and go up the stairs, leading you to a lift. Ride the lift going up. Once you arrive at the top of the place, you will see Ansbach right beside the lift. Go through the archway and up the stairs directly in front of you, and you will discover the Divine Gate Front Staircase See Elden Ring Map.

Promised Consort Radahn

As you reach the top of the stairs, you will find a boss fog that you can pass through. If you go through it, a cutscene will trigger, showing a familiar character that you have once fought. It is then revealed that the boss that you are going to face is Promised Consort Radahn. Radahn will be using the Starscourge Greatsword once again, even using an attack similar to the Starcaller Cry. He will also be using gravity orbs from afar, guaranteeing that you won't feel safe even if you are very far from him. He can also pull you or push you away from him using gravity.
